summary: Decision models such as Jev have emerged as a highly promising paradigm for LLM agent systems, providing lightweight and reliable categorical reasoning for rapid System One execution. However, existing generation-oriented inference engines fail to support these workloads effectively, suffering from severe prefix recomputation overheads or distorted output probabilities. To address this challenge, we propose Flide, an efficient and exact inference engine that decouples the logical tree structure of a decision request from its physical execution within a single flattened token stream. Through ForkAttention, Flide navigates request dependencies using GPU-resident indices across both standard attention and recurrent Gated DeltaNet layers, guaranteeing in exact arithmetic that every query branch evaluates identically to an isolated forward pass. By expressing branch topologies directly in GPU-resident metadata, Flide accommodates diverse request mixtures with a compact set of pre-recorded execution graphs while enabling expanding agent histories to resume from checkpoints saved in earlier passes. Extensive evaluations on public hybrid and decision models demonstrate that Flide answers queries up to 9.5 times faster than vLLM and SGLang while staying closest to a float32 reference in total variation distance. By unifying physical execution throughput with mathematical exactness, Flide establishes a principled foundation for scalable, latency-critical decision intelligence in agent systems.
title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking

title_translated: Flide：通过精确状态分叉加速决策推理
summary_translated: 决策模型如Jev已成为大语言模型智能体系统中极具前景的范式，为快速的系统一执行提供了轻量且可靠的分类推理。然而，现有的生成导向推理引擎无法有效支持此类工作负载，存在严重的前缀重新计算开销或输出概率失真问题。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了Flide，一种高效且精确的推理引擎，将决策请求的逻辑树结构与其在单一扁平化标记流中的物理执行解耦。通过ForkAttention，Flide利用GPU驻留索引在标准注意力和循环门控DeltaNet层之间导航请求依赖关系，确保每个查询分支在精确算术下与独立前向传播完全一致。通过将分支拓扑直接表达为GPU驻留元数据，Flide以一组预记录的执行图即可适应多样化的请求混合，并支持扩展的智能体历史从早期传递中保存的检查点恢复。在公开的混合模型和决策模型上的大量评估表明，Flide的查询响应速度比vLLM和SGLang快达9.5倍，同时在总变差距离上最接近浮点32位参考结果。通过统一物理执行吞吐量与数学精确性，Flide为智能体系统中可扩展、低延迟的关键决策智能奠定了原则性基础。

summary: Decision models target structured tasks by directly predicting choices or scores, avoiding autoregressive decoding latency. However, transferring a generative LLM's ranking knowledge to a decision model remains challenging: the teacher expresses preferences through a ranked list of document ID sequences, while the student determines the ranking using scores from the first-token position. To bridge this gap, we introduce DecisionRank, a decision model trained through item-space on-policy distillation (OPD). Item-space OPD constructs the student's rollout by sorting its document scores into a ranked sequence. A generative teacher takes the resulting ranking list as inputs and provides conditional feedback to directly supervise those scores. Combined with offline ranking supervision, DecisionRank achieves state-of-the-art performance on both general and reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmarks such as TREC DL, BEIR, and BRIGHT. Across four benchmarks, item-space OPD consistently outperforms alternative training objectives. Even at 1.7B parameters, DecisionRank surpasses its 27B generative teacher on TREC DL19--23. At 8B, it outperforms its generative listwise counterpart while running $24.5\times$ faster on TREC DL and $16.7\times$ faster on BRIGHT.
title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
title_translated: DecisionRank：用于决策模型重排序器的策略内蒸馏
summary_translated: 决策模型通过直接预测选择或得分来处理结构化任务，避免了自回归解码的延迟。然而，将生成式大语言模型的排序知识迁移到决策模型仍具挑战性：教师模型通过文档ID序列的排序列表表达偏好，而学生模型则通过首个标记位置的得分来确定排序。为弥合这一差距，我们提出DecisionRank，一种通过项目空间策略内蒸馏（OPD）训练的决策模型。项目空间OPD通过将文档得分排序形成排序序列来构建学生的推演路径。生成式教师将所得排序列表作为输入，提供条件反馈以直接监督这些得分。结合离线排序监督，DecisionRank在通用和推理密集型检索基准（如TREC DL、BEIR和BRIGHT）上均达到领先性能。在四个基准测试中，项目空间OPD始终优于其他训练目标。即使在17亿参数规模下，DecisionRank在TREC DL19–23上也超越了其270亿参数的生成式教师；在80亿参数规模下，其性能超过生成式列表方法，且在TREC DL上运行速度快24.5倍，在BRIGHT上快16.7倍。

summary: The quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models (LLMs). A variety of approaches have attempted to circumvent this, but they either fail to match attention's expressiveness (e.g., sliding-window or linear attention variants with fixed-size state) or only achieve constant-factor speedups (e.g., sparse attention methods whose indexers themselves scale quadratically). In this paper, we derive an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method based on a hierarchical, tree-structured indexer, which we call Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA). ZHA constructs a tree of recursively compressed key summaries over the KV cache, which future queries traverse from the top down to retrieve a sparse subset of keys. Crucially, by iteratively growing the tree's depth, the total cost including routing and final attention grows sublinearly in sequence length, resulting in overall subquadratic (but superlinear) scaling for attention. We demonstrate that ZHA can be cheaply applied to existing pretrained models with only a short KL distillation training stage over a few billion tokens, and maintains performance on long-context retrieval and challenging reasoning, mathematical, and agentic coding evaluation tasks. Moreover, we show that our method is highly robust to tree geometry including very deep trees of up to 6 levels. Finally, we develop a detailed performance model and show that our approach scales subquadratically, dramatically outperforms competing methods beyond 1 million context, and ultimately has the potential to extend effective context windows to the hundreds of millions or billions of tokens.
title: Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer
title_translated: 基于分层树状索引器的亚二次注意力机制
summary_translated: 注意力机制的二次复杂度是限制大语言模型长上下文能力的根本瓶颈。尽管已有多种方法尝试突破此限制，但它们要么无法匹配注意力的表达能力（如滑动窗口或线性注意力变体使用固定大小状态），要么仅实现常数因子的速度提升（如稀疏注意力方法，其索引器本身仍呈二次增长）。本文提出一种渐近亚二次稀疏注意力方法，基于分层树状索引器，称为Zyphra分层注意力（ZHA）。ZHA在KV缓存上构建递归压缩的键摘要树，未来查询从顶层向下遍历以检索稀疏的键子集。关键在于，通过迭代增加树的深度，包括路由和最终注意力在内的总成本在序列长度上呈次线性增长，从而实现整体亚二次（但超线性）的注意力扩展。我们证明，ZHA可低成本应用于现有预训练模型，仅需在数十亿标记上进行短时KL蒸馏训练，且在长上下文检索、复杂推理、数学和智能体编码等评估任务中保持性能。此外，我们展示了该方法对树结构几何的高度鲁棒性，包括高达6层的深层树。最后，我们建立了详细的性能模型，表明本方法具有亚二次扩展性，在上下文超过百万后显著优于竞争方法，最终有潜力将有效上下文窗口扩展至数亿甚至数十亿标记。

summary: Continuous diffusion language models show promising potential in text generation tasks, but are prone to problems such as text repetition, semantic drift, and generation quality degradation when the generation length exceeds the training length. To address these challenges, we propose RangeSWA, a training-free length extrapolation method. The method combines local sliding-window attention, remote block summaries, and dynamic content retrieval to preserve local details and support long-range context access. In addition, generation degradation caused by length extrapolation is mitigated through positional remapping, conditioning attention correction, and denoising-stage-adaptive window scheduling. We conducted experiments on multiple continuous diffusion language models, and the results show that RangeSWA can effectively reduce generative perplexity and text repetition rates in long-text generation.
title: RangeSWA: Training-Free Length Extrapolation for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
title_translated: RangeSWA：连续扩散语言模型的无训练长度外推方法
summary_translated: 连续扩散语言模型在文本生成任务中展现出巨大潜力，但在生成长度超过训练长度时，容易出现文本重复、语义漂移和生成质量下降等问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出RangeSWA，一种无需训练的长度外推方法。该方法结合局部滑动窗口注意力、远程块摘要和动态内容检索，以保留局部细节并支持长程上下文访问。此外，通过位置重映射、条件注意力校正和去噪阶段自适应窗口调度，缓解了因长度外推导致的生成退化问题。我们在多个连续扩散语言模型上进行了实验，结果表明，RangeSWA能有效降低长文本生成中的生成困惑度和文本重复率。

summary: Conversational assistants are expected to help people with diverse backgrounds, preferences, and communication styles. Yet evaluations centered on a single cooperative user provide limited insight into how reliably an assistant serves users with different personas. We introduce PersonaChatBench, a framework for evaluating task competence and responsiveness to diverse user needs. PersonaChatBench pairs the same underlying task with multiple simulated users, each guided by a private persona card that specifies distinct needs, preferences, and interaction behaviors. By holding the task fixed while varying the user, the framework examines how assistant performance changes across user conditions. We evaluate 20 language models across six domains, separately assessing native task outcomes, fulfillment of expressed persona needs, and simulator fidelity. Our results show that task performance and need fulfillment vary across personas and domains. Strong task performance does not necessarily translate into satisfying individual needs, and models' relative strengths in meeting those needs are not consistent across domains. PersonaChatBench makes these differences measurable, revealing gaps obscured by aggregate scores and helping identify which users an assistant serves well and where adaptation is needed. It provides a basis for evaluating consistency across users and guiding the development of assistants that better accommodate diverse needs in everyday applications.
title: PersonaChatBench: Evaluating Chat Assistants with Diverse Simulated Users
title_translated: PersonaChatBench：基于多样化模拟用户的聊天助手评估框架
summary_translated: 对话助手应能帮助具有不同背景、偏好和沟通风格的人群。然而，以单一合作用户为中心的评估难以揭示助手在服务不同人格特征用户时的可靠性。我们提出PersonaChatBench，一个用于评估任务胜任力和对多样化用户需求响应能力的框架。PersonaChatBench将相同底层任务与多个模拟用户配对，每个用户由一个私有的角色卡引导，明确其独特的需求、偏好和互动行为。通过固定任务而变化用户，该框架考察助手在不同用户条件下表现的变化。我们在六个领域对20个语言模型进行了评估，分别分析原生任务结果、所表达角色需求的满足程度以及模拟器保真度。结果显示，任务表现和需求满足度随角色和领域而异。强任务表现并不必然意味着满足个体需求，且模型在满足需求方面的相对优势在不同领域间不一致。PersonaChatBench使这些差异可测量，揭示了被平均分数掩盖的差距，有助于识别助手擅长服务哪些用户以及需要改进的领域。它为评估跨用户一致性提供了基础，并指导开发更适应日常应用中多样化需求的助手。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become the standard method for training language models to reason. However, RLVR typically relies solely on outcome correctness, which does not guarantee that the CoT causally contributes to the final answer. Without this connection, outcome rewards may fail to reinforce high-quality reasoning. Existing causality metrics assess CoT causality by perturbing the CoT, such as deleting reasoning steps or injecting errors, and measuring changes in the final answer. However, these perturbations inevitably alter information in each step. Consequently, high causality scores may reflect sensitivity to information changes introduced by perturbation rather than true causality. Such confounding effects further induce undesirable reasoning behaviors when these metrics are used as training rewards, including generating less informative CoTs and reducing exploration and self-correction. To address this problem, we propose CRoS (Causality Reward on Scrambled CoTs), a novel CoT causality metric that perturbs the order of reasoning steps without altering content, thereby preserving information within each step. On Reasoning Gym with Gemma-3-4B, CRoS outperforms existing causality and outcome rewards in out-of-domain accuracy, CoT quality, and CoT faithfulness. Specifically, CRoS achieves 46.8% accuracy on five unseen logic and games datasets, outperforming the strongest baseline (43.8%). It also achieves better CoT quality, consistently outperforming baselines in CoT-Pass@K from K=1 to 128, averaging 43.4% vs. 41.4%. For CoT faithfulness, CRoS achieves a hint acknowledgment score of 34.0% vs. 20.2%.
title: CRoS: Causality Reward on Scrambled CoTs Improves Accuracy and Reasoning Faithfulness

title_translated: CRoS：在打乱的思维链上使用因果奖励提升准确率与推理忠实性
summary_translated: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为训练语言模型进行推理的标准方法。然而，RLVR通常仅依赖结果正确性，这并不能保证思维链（CoT）对最终答案具有因果贡献。若缺乏这种关联，结果奖励可能无法强化高质量的推理过程。现有的因果性度量通过扰动思维链（如删除推理步骤或注入错误）并测量最终答案的变化来评估CoT的因果性。但这些扰动不可避免地改变了每一步的信息内容，导致高因果性评分可能反映的是对扰动引入信息变化的敏感性，而非真正的因果关系。这种混淆效应在将此类度量用作训练奖励时，会引发不良的推理行为，例如生成信息量较少的CoT、减少探索和自我修正。为解决该问题，我们提出CRoS（在打乱的CoT上使用因果奖励），一种新型的CoT因果性度量，其通过打乱推理步骤的顺序而不改变内容，从而保留每一步的信息。在Reasoning Gym上使用Gemma-3-4B模型进行测试，CRoS在跨域准确率、CoT质量及CoT忠实性方面均优于现有因果性和结果奖励。具体而言，CRoS在五个未见的逻辑与游戏数据集上达到46.8%的准确率，优于最强基线（43.8%）。在CoT质量方面，CRoS在K=1至128的所有CoT-Pass@K指标中持续优于基线，平均达43.4% vs. 41.4%。在CoT忠实性方面，CRoS的提示承认得分达到34.0% vs. 20.2%。

summary: The order in which tokens are predicted in language modeling has a profound impact on the quality of generated sequences. Autoregressive and masked diffusion models iteratively fill in tokens and can exploit such orderings across generation steps, but how to leverage an ordering for one-step parallel language modeling is unclear. We introduce asynchronous flow map language models (aFMLMs), which incorporate prediction order into one-step modeling by learning the flow maps of asynchronous flows. These flows specify an ordering through a tokenwise time schedule that controls the relative denoising progress of tokens. We formulate a general class of asynchronous flows that admit both prescribed and learned, state-adaptive schedules, show that they define valid flow maps, and develop new methods for their flow map distillation. The resulting models can generate all tokens in a single forward pass by internalizing the ordering encoded in the flow into their hidden computations. On Sudoku solving and code generation for GSM8K math word problems, aFMLM establishes new state-of-the-art one-step performance.
title: Asynchronous Flow Map Language Models

title_translated: 异步流映射语言模型
summary_translated: 语言建模中token预测的顺序对生成序列的质量有深远影响。自回归和掩码扩散模型通过迭代填充token，可以利用生成步骤间的顺序，但如何在一阶段并行语言建模中利用顺序仍不明确。我们引入异步流映射语言模型（aFMLMs），通过学习异步流的流映射，将预测顺序融入一阶段建模。这些流通过逐token的时间调度来指定顺序，控制各token的去噪进度相对关系。我们提出了一个通用的异步流类别，支持预设和学习的、状态自适应的调度策略，证明其定义了有效的流映射，并开发了新的流映射蒸馏方法。由此产生的模型可通过内部化流中编码的顺序信息，在单次前向传播中生成所有token。在数独求解和GSM8K数学应用题的代码生成任务中，aFMLM实现了新的单阶段性能基准。

summary: This paper presents TurnTurk-GPT, a text-based turn-taking predictor for Turkish obtained by fine-tuning a Turkish GPT-2 model with the TurnGPT objective on synthetic and real dialogue, and evaluates it on real Turkish conversation against rule baselines, a zero-shot Turkish language model and a widely used multilingual end-of-turn detector. Evaluation uses word-level decision points on unpunctuated, lower-cased text approximating the output of streaming speech recognisers, recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint folds, nested threshold selection and paired cluster bootstrap tests. TurnTurk-GPT outperforms the multilingual detector under both recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint evaluation. It outperforms the zero-shot language model only when the test speakers occur in training; on unseen speakers the two are statistically indistinguishable. Removing the suffixes of the turn-final word reduces AP by up to 44%, against 2% for a sentence-internal word, locating the Turkish end-of-turn cue in verb-final morphology. Synthetic dialogue alone yields the weakest trained model, and when a speaker pauses the zero-shot and multilingual baselines remain close to chance. The model and the evaluation protocol are publicly released.
title: TurnTurk-GPT: Text-Based Turn-Taking Prediction for Turkish
title_translated: TurnTurk-GPT：面向土耳其语的文本型轮流预测
summary_translated: 本文提出TurnTurk-GPT，一种通过在合成与真实对话上微调土耳其语GPT-2模型并采用TurnGPT目标函数训练得到的文本型轮流预测器，用于预测土耳其语对话中的发言轮次切换。在真实土耳其语对话中，将其与规则基线、零样本土耳其语语言模型以及广泛使用的多语言句末检测器进行对比评估。评估基于未标点、小写化的词级决策点，模拟流式语音识别器输出，采用记录无关和说话人无关的划分方式，结合嵌套阈值选择与配对聚类Bootstrap检验。TurnTurk-GPT在记录无关和说话人无关评估中均优于多语言检测器。仅当测试说话人出现在训练集中时，其才优于零样本语言模型；在未见说话人情况下，两者统计上无差异。移除发言结束词的后缀会使平均精度（AP）下降高达44%，而句内词仅下降2%，表明土耳其语句末提示位于动词结尾形态。仅使用合成对话训练的模型表现最弱；当说话人停顿时，零样本和多语言基线仍接近随机水平。模型与评估协议已公开发布。

summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance across a wide range of reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations and decision criteria align with the latent structure of human cognition. In this work, we propose a novel framework to align MLLMs with the multidimensional mental representations underlying human similarity judgements. We build on a previously established behavior-derived semantic embedding space, in which objects are represented along 66 interpretable dimensions derived from 4.70 million human Odd-One-Out (O1O) judgements. For each triplet, we infer the most salient decision dimension and convert it into a dimension-grounded linguistic rationale. This enables MLLMs to learn both the final choice and a justification consistent with the inferred behavioral criterion. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves model consistency with human similarity judgements while retaining competitive performance on standard multimodal benchmarks. Furthermore, using searchlight Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) on an independent fMRI Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD), we observe increased representational alignment between model and human. Ultimately, our findings point to a data-driven route for incorporating human cognitive structure into MLLMs alignment. The code is available \href{https://github.com/ening-open/cogalign}{here}.
title: Aligning MLLMs with the Latent Structure of Human Cognition via Behavior-Derived Semantic Dimensions
title_translated: 通过行为衍生语义维度对齐多模态大语言模型与人类认知的潜在结构
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在众多推理任务中取得了令人瞩目的性能，但其内部表示与决策标准是否与人类认知的潜在结构对齐仍不清晰。本文提出一种新框架，旨在使MLLMs与人类相似性判断背后的多维心理表征对齐。我们基于先前建立的行为衍生语义嵌入空间，其中对象沿66个可解释维度进行表征，这些维度源自470万条人类‘奇数出列’（O1O）判断。对于每个三元组，我们推断最显著的决策维度，并将其转化为基于维度的语言理由。这使得MLLMs能够同时学习最终选择和与推断行为准则一致的解释。实验结果表明，该方法提升了模型与人类相似性判断的一致性，同时在标准多模态基准测试中保持了竞争力。此外，通过对独立fMRI自然场景数据集（NSD）使用搜索光束表示相似性分析（RSA），我们观察到模型与人类表征之间的对齐程度提高。最终，我们的研究指明了一条数据驱动的路径，将人类认知结构融入MLLMs的对齐过程中。代码已公开于https://github.com/ening-open/cogalign。

summary: Knowledge tracing (KT) predicts a student's next response from their history. New platforms often have question texts but no response logs for training, motivating zero-shot cross-domain KT. Existing transfer and cold-start methods use question semantics, but cross-platform semantic discrepancies limit transferability. We propose TIZSKT, which separates behavioral sequence modeling from domain-local historical evidence construction and uses text as an index rather than a directly transferable predictive representation. The Mastery-Dynamics Encoder learns correctness dynamics without question identifiers or text embeddings. Domain-Local Question Addressing builds fixed question addresses using a frozen text encoder and an unsupervised per-domain projection. The Text-Addressing Kernel uses these addresses to aggregate the current student's previous outcomes into a question-specific historical correctness summary. Cross-Segment Continuation retains access to earlier responses without extending the behavioral encoder's input sequence. Evidence-Volume Read-Out preserves the total kernel mass discarded by normalization and combines its log-compressed value with the behavioral state and historical correctness summary to predict the next response. All trainable parameters are learned from source domains; target inference uses public question texts and the current student's observed history without target-domain training. Leave-one-domain-out experiments on three public datasets show that TIZSKT achieves the highest mean AUC and accuracy among evaluated baselines on all target domains. Ablations confirm the contributions of text addressing and cross-segment continuation.
title: Text as an Index for Zero-Shot Cross-Domain Knowledge Tracing
title_translated: 文本作为零样本跨领域知识追踪的索引
summary_translated: 知识追踪（KT）旨在根据学生的历史行为预测其下一次回答。新平台常仅有题目文本而无响应日志用于训练，推动了零样本跨领域KT的发展。现有迁移与冷启动方法依赖题目语义，但跨平台语义差异限制了可迁移性。我们提出TIZSKT，将行为序列建模与领域本地历史证据构建分离，并使用文本作为索引而非直接可迁移的预测表示。Mastery-Dynamics Encoder在无需题目标识符或文本嵌入的情况下学习正确性动态。Domain-Local Question Addressing通过冻结的文本编码器和无监督的领域特定投影构建固定题目地址。Text-Addressing Kernel利用这些地址聚合当前学生的先前结果，形成针对题目的历史正确性摘要。Cross-Segment Continuation在不延长行为编码器输入序列的前提下，保留对早期响应的访问。Evidence-Volume Read-Out保留归一化过程中丢弃的总核质量，并将其对数压缩值与行为状态和历史正确性摘要结合，以预测下一次回答。所有可训练参数均从源领域学习；目标推理仅需公开题目文本和当前学生的观测历史，无需目标领域训练。在三个公开数据集上的留一域外实验显示，TIZSKT在所有目标领域中均达到最高平均AUC和准确率。消融实验确认了文本索引和跨段延续机制的贡献。

summary: Conversational explainable AI (ConvXAI) agents often use GUS-style architectures with separate modules for intent recognition, dialogue management, and template-based response generation. While faithful to the underlying XAI methods, these pipelines are hard to adapt and often struggle with context-dependent follow-up questions. We present SimXAI, a lightweight LLM-centric conversational layer that replaces these modules with a single tool-calling LLM that bridges access to existing XAI resources. Rather than a standalone agent, SimXAI serves as a modular interface that enables conversational access to external XAI resources. We further introduce an evaluation suite for single- and multi-turn parsing, faithfulness, and contextualization. Across existing and new datasets, SimXAI achieves strong function-selection accuracy and high faithfulness while better handling context-dependent requests. In a user study replacing only the conversational layer of TalkToModel, a representative GUS-based agent, users completed tasks more accurately and in fewer turn. Overall, SimXAI improves GUS-based design while preserving faithfulness and improving conversational quality.
title: SimXAI: A Simple Drop-in Layer Increases Interaction Quality and Understanding in Conversational XAI
title_translated: SimXAI：一种简单的插入式层提升对话式可解释AI的交互质量与理解能力
summary_translated: 对话式可解释AI（ConvXAI）代理通常采用GUS风格的架构，包含意图识别、对话管理以及基于模板的响应生成等独立模块。尽管忠实于底层的可解释AI方法，这些流水线难以适应且常在处理上下文相关的后续问题时表现不佳。我们提出SimXAI，一种轻量级的以大语言模型为中心的对话层，用单一工具调用的大语言模型替代原有模块，从而连接现有可解释AI资源。SimXAI并非独立智能体，而是一个模块化接口，实现对外部可解释AI资源的对话式访问。我们还引入了一个评估套件，用于单轮和多轮解析、忠实度及上下文化评估。在现有和新数据集上，SimXAI实现了高函数选择准确率和高忠实度，同时更好地处理上下文依赖请求。在用户研究中，仅替换TalkToModel（一个典型的GUS基础代理）的对话层后，用户完成任务更准确且回合数更少。总体而言，SimXAI在保持忠实度的同时提升了GUS架构的设计质量并改善了对话体验。

summary: While sentence embeddings are primarily designed for semantic generalization, their latent geometry implicitly encodes surface-level lexical properties, a relationship that remains poorly understood. Shallow pooling methods discard word order, while deep Transformer models obscure these lexical alignments behind computational complexity and uninterpretable spaces. We propose constructing sentence embeddings via the path signature of Word2Vec trajectories, leveraging the iterated integrals of rough path theory to create representations that explicitly capture sequential and lexical structure in a geometrically tractable manner. Through extensive ablations spanning Word2Vec dimensions, signature depths, and PCA compression, we correlate embedding distances against five lexical string metrics: Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, word Jaccard, phoneme Levenshtein, and character TF-IDF. We reveal that while average pooling almost entirely fails to capture character-level edit distances, path signatures strongly align with them, with depth 2 signatures optimally balancing character and word-level sensitivities. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the critical lexical variance is concentrated in a highly compact PCA subspace, and unlike pooling, signatures structurally preserve and quantify word order. These findings establish path signatures not as semantic generalizers, but as rigorous mathematical lenses that explicitly encode discrete lexical structures and word order, offering an interpretable alternative to opaque deep learning for lexical tracking.
title: Iterated Integrals as Lexical Fingerprints: Path Signature Embeddings for Lexical Similarity
title_translated: 迭代积分作为词汇指纹：路径签名嵌入用于词汇相似性
summary_translated: 尽管句子嵌入主要设计用于语义泛化，其潜在几何结构隐含编码了表层词汇属性，这一关系仍不清晰。浅层池化方法会丢弃词序信息，而深层Transformer模型则在计算复杂性和不可解释的空间中掩盖了这些词汇对齐。我们提出通过Word2Vec轨迹的路径签名构建句子嵌入，利用粗糙路径理论中的迭代积分，以几何上可处理的方式显式捕捉序列和词汇结构。通过涵盖Word2Vec维度、签名深度和PCA压缩的广泛消融实验，我们将嵌入距离与五种词汇字符串度量（Levenshtein、Jaro-Winkler、词Jaccard、音素Levenshtein和字符TF-IDF）进行关联。结果表明，平均池化几乎完全无法捕捉字符级编辑距离，而路径签名则与其高度一致，其中深度为2的签名在字符与词级敏感性之间达到最优平衡。此外，我们发现关键的词汇方差集中在高度紧凑的PCA子空间中，且与池化不同，路径签名在结构上保留并量化了词序。这些发现表明路径签名并非语义泛化器，而是严格的数学透镜，显式编码离散词汇结构和词序，为词汇追踪提供了一种可解释的替代方案，优于模糊的深度学习方法。

summary: Taxonomy construction is essential for knowledge-intensive NLP yet remains costly: clustering-based methods (i) need careful per-corpus tuning and yield unstable hierarchies, while LLM-based pipelines (ii) depend on expensive task-specific training that does not transfer across domains. We report an empirical finding that bears on both: in Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) embeddings, where each leading prefix is itself a usable, coarser vector, prefix length aligns with the coarse-to-fine granularity of gold taxonomies; shuffled- and reverse-dimension controls isolate the alignment to the learned early prefix dimensions. The pattern holds across three architecturally distinct MRL models. To test whether this regularity is usable, we introduce PEEL (Peeling Embeddings to Extract Latent ontologies): a minimal probe over these frozen embeddings, trained once with an order-embedding objective that represents hierarchy as vector containment; a minimum spanning arborescence then decodes taxonomic DAGs. Using only a concept vocabulary (no documents), PEEL recovers taxonomic DAGs with high structural fidelity on two OLLM benchmarks, transferring to a new domain with no target-edge supervision. The end-to-end OLLM pipeline, which jointly discovers concepts and induces structure from document corpora, is reported as a cross-task reference. Pre-trained retrieval embeddings encode a decodable granularity gradient; a minimal probe renders it as explicit parent-child (is-a) structure.
title: Peeling the Matryoshka: Extracting Ontological Structure from Retrieval Embeddings

title_translated: 剥开套娃：从检索嵌入中提取本体结构
summary_translated: 本体构建对于知识密集型自然语言处理至关重要，但成本高昂：基于聚类的方法（i）需要针对每个语料库精细调参，且产生不稳定的层次结构；而基于大语言模型的流水线（ii）依赖昂贵的任务特定训练，且难以跨领域迁移。我们报告了一个与两者相关的重要实证发现：在Matryoshka表示学习（MRL）嵌入中，每个前缀本身就是一个可用的粗粒度向量，前缀长度与真实本体的粗粒度到细粒度粒度对齐；通过打乱和反向维度控制，可将这种对齐隔离至早期学习的前缀维度。该模式在三种架构不同的MRL模型中均成立。为验证该规律是否可用，我们提出PEEL（剥取嵌入以提取潜在本体）：一种对这些冻结嵌入的最小探测器，通过一次训练的顺序嵌入目标（将层次结构表示为向量包含关系），再通过最小生成树有向图解码出本体DAG。仅使用概念词汇表（无需文档），PEEL在两个OLLMBench基准上以高结构保真度恢复本体DAG，并在无目标边监督的情况下迁移到新领域。端到端的OLLMBench流水线联合发现概念并从文档语料库中推导结构，作为跨任务参考。预训练的检索嵌入编码了一个可解码的粒度梯度；最小探测器将其转化为显式的父-子（is-a）结构。

summary: Reasoning distillation is widely used to transfer the reasoning capabilities of large language models to smaller students through teacher-generated supervision. In the black-box setting, however, teachers may expose only final answers and brief solutions, leaving intermediate calculations and validity conditions unavailable and thus limiting the reasoning supervision available for distillation. We propose Stepwise Querying, which elicits step-specific explanations without requiring access to the teacher's internal chain-of-thought (CoT) traces. Independent queries to the same teacher request intermediate derivations, validity checks, and corrections for individual steps, the assembled solutions are then used for standard supervised fine-tuning. Across two teachers, two students, and four mathematics and code benchmarks, our method achieves the highest score in 14 of 16 comparisons with three baselines. We further introduce Stepwise Explanation Information Gain (SEIG), a diagnostic based on the log-ratio of a frozen student's probabilities of correct step completion under stepwise and global explanations. Analyses on GSM8K show that incorrect-answer trajectories can remain useful when they preserve valid intermediate reasoning, while further decomposition yields limited additional gains.
title: Stepwise-Querying: Distilling Reasoning without Access to Teacher Chain-of-Thought
title_translated: 分步查询：在无法访问教师思维链的情况下提炼推理能力
summary_translated: 推理蒸馏被广泛用于通过教师生成的监督信号，将大型语言模型的推理能力转移到较小的学生模型。然而，在黑盒设置下，教师可能仅暴露最终答案和简短解答，导致中间计算和有效性条件不可用，从而限制了可用于蒸馏的推理监督。我们提出分步查询（Stepwise Querying），在无需访问教师内部思维链（CoT）痕迹的情况下，获取特定步骤的解释。对同一教师发起独立查询，请求各个步骤的中间推导、有效性检查和修正，然后将组装后的解决方案用于标准监督微调。在两个教师、两个学生和四个数学与代码基准上的实验表明，我们的方法在16次比较中有14次取得最高得分。我们进一步引入分步解释信息增益（SEIG），一种基于冻结学生在分步与全局解释下正确步骤完成概率的对数比的诊断指标。在GSM8K上的分析显示，即使答案错误，只要保留有效的中间推理，轨迹仍可能有用；而进一步分解带来的额外收益有限。

summary: The needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) benchmark was introduced as a test for measuring a model's ability to find small relevant facts within a very large body of input text. However, existing NIAH benchmarks each suffer from one or more of the following limitations: (1) reliance on synthetic data, so their evaluations may not generalize to real-world settings; (2) reuse of previously published datasets, leading to the risk of benchmark contamination; (3) dependence on manual annotation, which requires human effort to create and update data and is prone to future benchmark contamination; and (4) unrealistic simplification of long-context multi-hop reasoning where each next step is trivial given previous steps, while real-world reasoning often requires planning over multiple possible proof paths. To address these limitations, we introduce \Benchmark, a dynamic benchmark built from real citation relationships among scientific papers published after the evaluated models' knowledge cutoff date, which utilizes real-world information while ensuring no benchmark contamination. The fully automated benchmark construction pipeline samples representative subgraphs of the citation graph formed by these papers and converts each subgraph into a long-context QA example with a verifiable answer. We use GraphNIAH to evaluate eight LLMs from the GPT-5.6, Gemini-3, and Qwen3.5 families. We find that accuracy falls as questions require longer reasoning paths: at question depths of 16 and 32, the GPT-5.6 and Qwen3.5 models answer YES/NO questions no better than random guessing, mostly by answering NO; four of the eight models answer no counting example correctly, and the others model get worse as the subgraph size increases. These findings suggest that current LLMs often stop searching the citation relationships in their context before they reach the answer, even though every fact they need is in the context.
title: GraphNIAH: A Benchmark for Long-Context Reasoning over Real-World Graphs
title_translated: GraphNIAH：面向现实世界图谱的长上下文推理基准
summary_translated: 针堆找针（NIAH）基准被引入以测试模型在大量输入文本中查找少量相关事实的能力。然而，现有NIAH基准普遍存在以下一个或多个局限：（1）依赖合成数据，导致评估结果可能无法推广至真实场景；（2）重复使用已发表的数据集，存在基准污染风险；（3）依赖人工标注，需人力创建和更新数据，且易引发未来基准污染；（4）对长上下文多跳推理的简化处理，每一步都因前序步骤而变得简单，而现实世界的推理往往需要在多个可能的证明路径上进行规划。为解决这些问题，我们引入GraphNIAH，一个基于真实论文引用关系构建的动态基准，这些论文发布于所评估模型的知识截止日期之后，确保使用真实世界信息的同时杜绝基准污染。全自动的基准构建流程从这些论文形成的引用图中采样代表性子图，并将每个子图转换为具有可验证答案的长上下文问答示例。我们使用GraphNIAH评估来自GPT-5.6、Gemini-3和Qwen3.5系列的八款大语言模型。结果发现，随着问题所需推理路径变长，准确率下降：当问题深度达到16和32时，GPT-5.6和Qwen3.5模型回答YES/NO问题的表现甚至不如随机猜测，多数情况下回答为NO；八款模型中有四款未能正确回答任何计数示例，其余模型在子图规模增大时表现更差。这些发现表明，当前大语言模型在达到答案之前便停止搜索上下文中的引用关系，尽管它们所需的所有事实实际上都在上下文中。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been adopted for Grammatical Error Correction (GEC), achieving strong performance via both full fine-tuning and prompt-based approaches. As probabilistic sequence models, LLMs expose inference-time parameters that directly modify token generation behavior; however, their potential for controlling GEC-specific trade-offs has not been systematically studied. In this work, we investigate decoding strategies for grammatical error correction. We show that the repetition penalty parameter enables controllable adjustment of the precision--recall trade-off at inference time, without modifying the model architecture, training procedure, or prompt. Through experiments on standard GEC benchmarks, we demonstrate that repetition-penalty-based decoding enables inference-time control of the precision--recall balance, conceptually related to methods previously proposed for sequence-to-sequence GEC models, such as Align-and-Predict Decoding (APD), while remaining simple and broadly applicable to existing LLMs that expose inference-time decoding penalties.
title: Precision--Recall Trade-off on the Inference Level for LLMs in Grammatical Error Correction
title_translated: 大语言模型在语法纠错中的精度-召回率权衡：推理层面的调整
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）最近被用于语法纠错（GEC），通过全微调和基于提示的方法取得了优异性能。作为概率序列模型，LLMs 在推理阶段暴露了可直接修改标记生成行为的参数；然而，这些参数在控制 GEC 特定精度-召回率权衡方面的潜力尚未得到系统研究。本文研究了语法纠错的解码策略，表明重复惩罚参数可在不修改模型架构、训练过程或提示的情况下，实现推理阶段对精度-召回率权衡的可控调节。在标准 GEC 基准上的实验表明，基于重复惩罚的解码方法能够实现推理阶段的精度-召回率平衡控制，这一概念与此前针对序列到序列 GEC 模型提出的 Align-and-Predict Decoding（APD）方法相关，同时保持简单且广泛适用于现有暴露推理阶段解码惩罚的大语言模型。

summary: Activation steering is an inference-time technique used to control or modify the behavior, tone, or safety properties of a large language model (LLM) without retraining the model's weights or editing its input prompt, but simply by adding a vector to its residual-stream activations. However, activation steering also changes the generated text in unintended ways, unrelated to intended behavior change, that are not well understood. Prior work has measured these changes only through coarse signals such as perplexity. In this work, we show that steering systematically produces significant changes in discourse dimensions of the generated text, such as its formality, use of evidence, and ambiguity. We present a way of countering this by adding a second, complementary vector that targets the affected discourse dimension. This intervention restores about 78% of the unintended discourse changes while preserving the intended steering behavior in about 93% of the generations.
title: When Steering Shifts Discourse: Identifying and Intervening on Discourse-Level Changes due to Activation Steering in LLMs
title_translated: 当引导改变话语时：识别并干预大语言模型激活引导引起的话语层面变化
summary_translated: 激活引导是一种推理阶段技术，无需重新训练模型权重或修改输入提示，仅通过向残差流激活添加向量即可控制或修改大语言模型（LLM）的行为、语气或安全属性。然而，激活引导也会以未预期的方式改变生成文本，这些变化与预期行为改变无关，且理解不足。先前工作仅通过困惑度等粗粒度信号衡量这些变化。本文表明，引导会系统性地引发生成文本在话语维度上的显著变化，如正式程度、证据使用和模糊性。我们提出一种通过添加第二个互补向量来抵消这些影响的方法，该干预措施恢复了约78%的非预期话语变化，同时在约93%的生成中保留了预期的引导行为。

summary: We release Saidzoda-Tajik-LFM-2.6B, a Tajik adaptation of the 2.6B-parameter hybrid model LFM2.5-2.6B-Base, built for tool calling in Tajik on modest hardware. The recipe has two stages: LoRA continued pretraining (CPT) on 1,485,319 cleaned Tajik web documents for 3 epochs, then one epoch of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on a mix of machine-translated Tajik tool calls, English tool calls kept as replay, and Tajik instructions. On a 174-item tool-calling test set built from BFCL v3 and machine-translated to Tajik, strict full-call accuracy on Tajik prompts rises from 20.69 for the base model to 64.14 (paired difference +43.45 points, 95% interval +35.2 to +51.7); a lenient parser that also accepts the base model's own call formats puts the base at 31.72. English shows no detectable change (76.55 and 77.24). Every CPT checkpoint scores zero: CPT removes the native tool-call format and, as the lenient re-scoring shows, part of the skill itself. Outside tool calling, accuracy on a Tajik knowledge benchmark rises from 28.0 to 35.0, Belebele Tajik shows no significant change, and English MMLU falls from 60.8 to 52.5. The model is not a general Tajik assistant. It almost never declines when no tool fits (6.9% correct on Tajik, against 31.0% for the base under the lenient parser), it is weak at multi-turn calls, and its calls should be checked before they are executed. We describe the data, the training settings and every evaluation in enough detail to repeat them.
title: Saidzoda-Tajik-LFM-2.6B: Adapting a 2.6B Hybrid Model to Tajik Tool Calling, and What Continued Pretraining Takes Away

title_translated: Saidzoda-Tajik-LFM-2.6B：将2.6B混合模型适配至塔吉克语工具调用，以及持续预训练带来的损失
summary_translated: 我们发布了 Saidzoda-Tajik-LFM-2.6B，这是基于 2.6B 参数的混合模型 LFM2.5-2.6B-Base 的塔吉克语版本，专为在有限硬件条件下实现塔吉克语工具调用而构建。该训练流程包含两个阶段：在 1,485,319 条清洗后的塔吉克语网页文档上进行 LoRA 持续预训练（CPT），共 3 个周期；随后在一个混合数据集上进行一周期监督微调（SFT），该数据集包括机器翻译的塔吉克语工具调用、保留原样作为回放的英文工具调用以及塔吉克语指令。在由 BFCL v3 构建并机器翻译为塔吉克语的 174 项工具调用测试集上，严格全调用准确率从基础模型的 20.69 提升至 64.14（配对差异 +43.45，95% 置信区间 +35.2 至 +51.7）；宽松解析器（也接受基础模型自身调用格式）下，基础模型得分为 31.72。英文表现无明显变化（76.55 和 77.24）。所有 CPT 检查点得分均为零：CPT 消除了原生工具调用格式，且宽松重评分显示部分技能本身也被削弱。在工具调用之外，塔吉克语知识基准准确率从 28.0 提升至 35.0，Belebele 塔吉克语无显著变化，英文 MMLU 从 60.8 下降至 52.5。该模型并非通用塔吉克语助手：它几乎从不拒绝无合适工具的情况（塔吉克语正确率为 6.9%，而基础模型在宽松解析下为 31.0%），多轮调用能力弱，其调用需执行前检查。我们详细描述了数据、训练设置及所有评估，以便复现。

summary: Unlike autoregressive (AR) models, diffusion language models (DLMs) permit parallel token updates, flexible generation, and bidirectional attention, but leading systems rely on costly pretraining or full-model fine-tuning. We present Build Your Own DLM (BYOD), a generalizable LoRA-only recipe for parameter-efficient AR-to-DLM conversion. Without architecture-specific tuning, BYOD induces diffusion generation in Gemma 2 9B, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen2.5 7B, and Ministral 8B; to our knowledge, this is the first reported AR-to-DLM conversion of a Mistral model. The adapters comprise 4.1-5.8% of final parameters while every base-model parameter remains frozen; each 25,000-iteration conversion needs at most 102.4M tokens, processed in 3.1-4.0 hours on one Google Colab GPU. All four models generate from fully masked sequences, use bidirectional context in a controlled attention test, and retain substantial parent-model knowledge. BYOD-Gemma is the strongest BYOD conversion on our nine-task evaluation, reaching 50.6% average accuracy compared with 51.9% for LLaDA 8B Instruct in the same harness. Open-generation quality at low network function evaluation (NFE) budgets remains the principal limitation: BYOD perplexity is 8.3-11.1 versus 4.1 for LLaDA and 2.2-3.0 for the AR parents when generating 128 tokens in 64 steps. To enable further experimentation and inspection, we provide a standalone training and evaluation implementation and interactive demos for all four conversions. BYOD thus provides a practical route for extending diffusion generation to other existing model families while identifying the gap that efficient conversion must next close.
title: BYOD: Build Your Own DLM - Efficient Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Language Model Conversion

title_translated: BYOD：构建你自己的扩散语言模型——高效自回归到扩散语言模型转换
summary_translated: 与自回归（AR）模型不同，扩散语言模型（DLMs）支持并行标记更新、灵活生成和双向注意力，但主流系统依赖昂贵的预训练或全模型微调。我们提出 Build Your Own DLM（BYOD），一种通用的仅 LoRA 的高效 AR 到 DLM 转换方案。无需特定架构调优，BYOD 成功在 Gemma 2 9B、Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen2.5 7B 和 Ministral 8B 上诱导出扩散生成；据我们所知，这是首次报告的 Mistral 模型的 AR 到 DLM 转换。适配器仅占最终参数的 4.1%-5.8%，所有基础模型参数保持冻结；每次 25,000 次迭代的转换最多需要 102.4M 标记，在单个 Google Colab GPU 上耗时 3.1-4.0 小时。四个模型均能从完全掩码序列生成，能在受控注意力测试中使用双向上下文，并保留大量父模型知识。BYOD-Gemma 在九任务评估中表现最强，平均准确率达 50.6%，略低于 LLaDA 8B Instruct 的 51.9%。在低网络函数评估（NFE）预算下的开放生成质量仍是主要限制：生成 128 个标记、64 步时，BYOD 困惑度为 8.3-11.1，而 LLaDA 为 4.1，AR 父模型为 2.2-3.0。为促进进一步实验与检验，我们提供了独立的训练与评估实现及四个转换的交互演示。BYOD 为将扩散生成扩展至其他现有模型家族提供了一条实用路径，同时指出了高效转换亟待填补的差距。

summary: This study examines digital sovereignty in professional translation through a screening of computer-assisted translation tools and translation management systems, and a case study of migrating a translator's workstation from Windows to Linux. The framework combines three principles - Control, Continuity and Exit - with three practical requirements: native Linux operation, independence from mandatory external services, and independent access to essential data and resources. Drawing on documentary evidence and the limited number of responses received from providers, the ecosystem screening distinguishes Linux accessibility from operational independence: browser-based platforms may remain dependent on provider-controlled infrastructure. The migration case demonstrates the feasibility of reconstructing one professional workflow around a locally operable Linux core, using LoopCAT, LibreOffice and locally run TranslateGemma, alongside tools for optical character recognition, communication, credential management and backup. Selected cloud services remained available where needed. The findings suggest that digital sovereignty depends on how workflow dependencies are organized, rather than on individual applications or operating systems. It does not require technological isolation, but meaningful control over essential components, continuity of work and practical exit options. The framework is tailored to the case examined here and may require adaptation to other professional workflows.
title: Digital sovereignty in professional translation workflows: a case study of migrating from Windows to Linux

title_translated: 专业翻译工作流中的数字主权：从 Windows 迁移到 Linux 的案例研究
summary_translated: 本研究通过审查计算机辅助翻译工具和翻译管理系统，并结合一个将译者工作站从 Windows 迁移至 Linux 的案例研究，探讨了专业翻译中的数字主权问题。框架融合了三个原则——控制、连续性和退出——以及三项实际要求：原生 Linux 运行、独立于强制外部服务、独立访问关键数据与资源。基于文献证据及少数供应商回复，生态筛选区分了 Linux 可用性与操作独立性：基于浏览器的平台可能仍依赖于供应商控制的基础设施。迁移案例展示了围绕本地可操作的 Linux 核心重构一个专业工作流的可行性，使用 LoopCAT、LibreOffice 和本地运行的 TranslateGemma，辅以光学字符识别、通信、凭证管理和备份工具。必要时部分云服务仍可使用。研究发现表明，数字主权取决于工作流依赖关系的组织方式，而非单一应用或操作系统。它不要求技术隔离，而是对关键组件的实际控制、工作的连续性以及可行的退出选项。该框架针对本案例定制，可能需适应其他专业工作流。

summary: Automatic assessment of textual CEFR levels is an important task in educational natural language processing. However, accurate CEFR level prediction remains challenging due to the naturally imbalanced distribution of CEFR levels and the ambiguous boundaries between adjacent levels. To address these challenges, we propose a unified training objective that combines focal loss with supervised contrastive learning. Focal loss mitigates class imbalance by emphasizing underrepresented and difficult examples, while supervised contrastive learning learns more discriminative representations by encouraging intra-class compactness and inter-class separation. We evaluate the proposed method on sentence- and document-level CEFR assessment in both monolingual and multilingual settings. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines across all settings, establishing new state-of-the-art performance on multiple CEFR assessment benchmarks.
title: CEFR Level Assessment across Languages and Text Granularities
title_translated: 跨语言与文本粒度的CEFR等级评估
summary_translated: 文本CEFR等级的自动评估是教育自然语言处理中的重要任务。然而，由于CEFR等级在自然分布上的不平衡以及相邻等级之间边界模糊，准确预测CEFR等级仍具挑战性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种统一的训练目标，结合焦点损失与有监督对比学习。焦点损失通过强调低频和困难样本缓解类别不平衡问题，而有监督对比学习则通过增强类内紧凑性和类间分离性来学习更具区分性的表示。我们在单语和多语环境下对句子级和文档级CEFR评估进行了实验验证。结果表明，该方法在所有设置下均持续优于强基线模型，在多个CEFR评估基准上建立了新的最先进性能。

summary: This study investigates the effectiveness of large pre-trained language models (LLMs) for knowledge entity relation extraction (KERE) from academic papers. Existing studies have examined individual types of LLM-based strategies and evaluated model performance using metrics such as precision and recall. To provide a broader evaluation, this study investigates multiple strategies, including closed-source LLM-based CoT prompting, LoRA-adapted open-source LLMs, LLM-enhanced small pre-trained language models (SLMs), and SLM-enhanced closed-source LLMs. In addition, this study introduces two strategies, namely SLM-enhanced open-source LLMs and closed-source LLM-enhanced open-source LLMs. These strategies are evaluated from multiple perspectives, including metrics, their ability to mitigate errors observed in SLMs, and potential directions for model optimization. This study manually constructs two annotated datasets in the NLP domain, covering Abstract and Full-Text datasets. Experimental results show that the LoRA-adapted T5 model achieves the highest macro F1 scores of 0.7408 and 0.7013 on the Abstract and Full-Text datasets, respectively. SLMs also benefit from LLM-generated entity descriptions under the LLM-enhanced SLM strategy. Error analysis further reveals that the effectiveness of LLM-based strategies in mitigating SLM errors varies across error types. Based on the identified limitations and error patterns of these strategies, several optimization directions are proposed. In addition, combining strategies with different error patterns further improves KERE performance.
title: Enhancing Knowledge Entity Relation Extraction in Abstracts and Full-text Content of Academic Articles Using Large Language Models
title_translated: 利用大语言模型增强学术论文摘要与全文内容中的知识实体关系抽取
summary_translated: 本研究探讨了大规模预训练语言模型（LLMs）在学术论文中知识实体关系抽取（KERE）任务中的有效性。现有研究主要关注单一类型的基于LLM的策略，并使用精确率、召回率等指标评估模型性能。为提供更全面的评估，本研究考察了多种策略，包括闭源LLM的思维链提示、LoRA微调的开源LLM、LLM增强的小型预训练语言模型（SLMs），以及SLM增强的闭源LLM。此外，还引入了两种新策略：SLM增强的开源LLM，以及闭源LLM增强的开源LLM。从多个角度进行评估，包括性能指标、缓解SLM错误的能力，以及模型优化的潜在方向。本研究手动构建了两个NLP领域的标注数据集，涵盖摘要和全文数据集。实验结果显示，LoRA微调的T5模型在摘要和全文数据集上分别取得了0.7408和0.7013的最高宏F1分数。SLMs在LLM生成的实体描述支持下，也受益于LLM增强的SLM策略。错误分析进一步揭示，基于LLM的策略在缓解SLM错误方面的有效性因错误类型而异。基于识别出的局限性和错误模式，提出了若干优化方向。此外，结合具有不同错误模式的策略可进一步提升KERE性能。

summary: Long-context diffusion repeatedly pays for both token interaction and feed-forward computation. We formulate these costs as two separate budgets: the edges available to an attention graph and the experts activated for each token. This view connects local, dilated, and global attention with conditional expert computation without assuming that sparsity alone preserves document-level information. We specify normalized masked attention, distinguish denoising depth from sampling iterations, and derive graph and compute bounds. A reported sparse-expert configuration, denoted DualBudget, is analyzed across scientific summarization, multi-hop question answering, dialogue, and sentence-pair prediction. All supplied table measurements are retained. The length study shows gains over the listed baselines through 16K, together with measurable degradation as length increases. Ablations reveal mixed changes across the three reported scores, while the cost record indicates a 20% reduction relative to DiffuSeq under an unspecified timing convention. The analysis separates these observations from unmeasured claims about training speed, absorbing states, global coherence, and deployment memory.
title: Sparse Text Diffusion under Dual Budgets: Context Connectivity and Expert Activation
title_translated: 双重预算下的稀疏文本扩散：上下文连通性与专家激活
summary_translated: 长上下文扩散过程需重复支付令牌交互与前馈计算的开销。我们将这些成本视为两个独立的预算：注意力图可用的边数，以及每个令牌激活的专家数量。这一视角将局部、稀疏和全局注意力与条件专家计算联系起来，无需假设稀疏性本身即可保留文档级信息。我们定义了归一化掩码注意力，区分去噪深度与采样迭代次数，并推导出图结构与计算量的边界。报告的稀疏专家配置（称为DualBudget）在科学摘要、多跳问答、对话和句子对预测任务中进行了分析。所有提供的表格测量值均被保留。长度研究显示，在16K长度范围内优于列出的基线，但随着长度增加出现可测量的性能下降。消融实验在三个报告得分上表现出混合变化，而成本记录显示相对于DiffuSeq在未指定时间约定下减少了20%。分析将这些观察结果与未经测量的训练速度、吸收态、全局连贯性和部署内存等说法区分开来。

summary: Recursive textual memory can carry earlier errors into later updates, yet task performance alone does not establish memory reliability. We define self-consistency bias as the persistence of incorrect claims already present in the incoming memory. We present KEEPER, a comparative analysis of four auxiliary objectives along information-content and update-sensitivity axes within a shared recursive interface, examining how supervision targets relate to agent performance. Among evaluated conditions, reward-related prediction achieve the highest task performance before and after offline reinforcement learning, outperforming joint supervision. A claim-level analysis of one baseline trajectory documents error persistence despite corrective observations. Together, these analyses motivate evaluating error persistence and valid-information retention alongside task outcomes.
title: KEEPER: Learning Control-Sufficient Textual Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
title_translated: KEEPER：面向长时程LLM智能体的学习控制充分文本记忆
summary_translated: 递归文本记忆可能将早期错误带入后续更新，但仅靠任务表现无法确立记忆的可靠性。我们定义了自我一致性偏差，即输入记忆中已存在的错误陈述持续存在。我们提出KEEPER，通过在共享递归接口内沿信息量和更新敏感性轴线，对四种辅助目标进行比较分析，探究监督目标与智能体性能之间的关系。在所评估的条件下，奖励相关预测在离线强化学习前后均取得最高任务表现，优于联合监督。对一个基线轨迹的逐条分析记录了尽管存在纠正性观察，错误仍持续存在。这些分析共同推动了在评估任务结果的同时，也应考察错误持续性和有效信息保留。

summary: Fine-tuning a language model changes how it responds, but where is this fine-tuned behavior instantiated? To better understand this, we evaluate whether the change in model behavior arises only during the generation of the answer tokens where the change manifests, or whether altered processing of previous tokens causes it via the attention mechanism. For this, we patch the KV cache from a LoRA fine-tuned model into the unmodified base model, and vice versa. Our results show that for some behaviors, like responding in German or emergent misalignment, patching the KV cache can indeed transfer them from the fine-tuned to the base model. Correspondingly, patching the KV cache from base to fine-tune can partially or fully remove fine-tuned behavior. Furthermore, we find that the effect of patching grows with how much of the KV cache is patched and concentrates at a few pivotal positions, with system-prompt and chat-template tokens having disproportionate influence.
title: KV-Cache Patching: Tracing How and Where Fine-Tuned Behaviors Arise
comment: Interpretability as a Science Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
title_translated: KV缓存修补：追踪微调行为的产生位置与方式
summary_translated: 微调语言模型会改变其响应方式，但这种微调行为具体体现在何处？为更好地理解这一点，我们评估了模型行为的变化是否仅在体现变化的答案令牌生成过程中发生，还是通过注意力机制改变了先前令牌的处理过程所致。为此，我们将LoRA微调模型的KV缓存替换到未修改的基础模型中，反之亦然。结果表明，对于某些行为（如以德语回应或涌现的不一致），将微调模型的KV缓存注入基础模型确实可以转移这些行为。相应地，将基础模型的KV缓存注入微调模型，可部分或完全消除微调行为。此外，我们发现修补效果随修补的KV缓存比例增加而增强，并集中在少数关键位置，其中系统提示词和聊天模板令牌具有不成比例的影响。

summary: Given that AI agents can search the web broadly and deeply in real time, it is tempting to conclude that their outputs account for recent world events. We show that this conclusion does not hold in practice. While agents can search and easily find recent changes, the correctness of their responses depends on whether they search and what they search for. Popular agentic search benchmarks like BrowseComp cannot expose failures wherein agents do not recognize their own assumptions that should be verified, since these benchmarks explicitly state what needs to be found. In contrast, many user requests state only the final information need (e.g., an itinerary for a trip), leaving the agent to discover relevant changes (e.g., the temporary closure of a museum) and account for their consequences. To highlight such gaps, we introduce BlindToChange, a benchmark that measures whether agents proactively discover recent events that affect their responses. Our benchmark comprises requests for recommendations where an obvious candidate is no longer applicable due to a recent real-world event. These events are drawn automatically from Wikidata, allowing BlindToChange to be periodically refreshed. Strikingly, we find a big gap -- as high as 27.5 points, even at high reasoning effort -- in systems' performance, when the recent event is not explicitly mentioned compared to when we ask about it directly. Analyzing search trajectories, we learn that more than half of the failures can be attributed to the fact that agents do not directly search to verify whether a relevant fact has changed. Our benchmark highlights, and tracks, a new axis of progress, wherein systems account for recent information that is not explicitly mentioned in the user request.
title: BlindToChange: AI Agents Can Find Changes When Asked But Do They Look When Needed?
title_translated: 盲点于变化：当被询问时，AI代理能发现变化吗？它们在需要时会查看吗？
summary_translated: 尽管AI代理能够实时广泛而深入地搜索网络，但其输出并不总能反映近期世界事件。我们发现，虽然代理可以搜索并轻松找到最新变化，但其回答的正确性取决于是否进行搜索以及搜索的内容。流行的代理搜索基准测试如BrowseComp无法暴露代理未能识别自身需验证假设的问题，因为这些基准明确指出了需要查找的内容。相比之下，许多用户请求仅说明最终信息需求（例如旅行行程），要求代理自行发现相关变化（如博物馆临时关闭）并考虑其后果。为揭示此类差距，我们提出了BlindToChange基准，用于衡量代理是否主动发现影响其回答的近期事件。该基准包含推荐请求，其中明显候选项因近期真实事件已不再适用。这些事件自动从Wikidata获取，使BlindToChange可定期更新。令人震惊的是，当最近事件未被明确提及与直接提问相比，系统性能差距高达27.5分，即使在高推理努力下依然存在。通过分析搜索轨迹，我们发现超过一半的失败源于代理未直接搜索以验证相关事实是否发生变化。该基准突显并追踪了一个新的进展维度：系统如何处理用户请求中未明确提及的最新信息。

summary: Growing submission volumes have renewed interest in using large language models (LLMs) to support peer review. It remains unclear how such evaluation should be structured, how much the model matters, and whether LLM scores predict research impact. We evaluate five paradigms across three input representations and three LLMs on 232 stratified ICLR 2025 submissions. Direct absolute rating matches comparative ranking on rank correlation with human scores, yet compresses most predictions above the accept threshold, flagging almost none of the papers reviewers scored below it. A base-rate-matched recalibration control locates the cause: comparative ranking supplies placement, not better ordering, and after recalibration Direct Rating reaches higher agreement than Elo while making 24% as many API calls. Abstract-only input beats full-paper summarization, and model choice matters as much as paradigm choice. Replicating on all 11,513 scored submissions reproduces these patterns, shows absolute agreement depends on the evaluated set's score spread, and finds none beating an always-reject baseline in accuracy. Human scores track citations better than any paradigm, with one exception: Group Rating retains its citation correlation after controlling for human scores, and alone ranks within the accepted pool. Ranking quality alone cannot assess review quality; calibration, thresholds, model, and target outcome all matter.
title: Comparative Evaluation of LLM-Based Review Paradigms for Academic Paper Quality Assessment
title_translated: 基于大语言模型的学术论文质量评估评审范式的比较评估
summary_translated: 投稿量的增长重新引发了使用大语言模型（LLMs）辅助同行评审的兴趣。然而，这种评估应如何结构化、模型本身有多重要，以及LLM评分是否能预测研究影响力仍不明确。我们在232篇分层的ICLR 2025提交论文上，对三种输入表示形式和三种LLMs下的五种范式进行了评估。直接绝对评分在与人类评分的相关性上与对比排名相当，但会压缩大部分高于接受阈值的预测结果，几乎未标记出评审员评分低于该阈值的论文。一个基于基线匹配的再校准对照实验揭示了原因：对比排名提供的是位置而非更优排序；再校准后，直接评分的共识度高于Elo方法，且API调用次数仅为后者的24%。仅使用摘要的输入优于全文摘要，且模型选择的重要性与范式选择相当。在全部11,513份已评分提交上的复现验证了这些模式，表明绝对一致性取决于评估集的分数分布，并发现没有任何范式在准确性上优于始终拒绝的基线。人类评分比任何范式更能预测引用次数，唯一例外是群体评分在控制人类评分后仍保持引用相关性，且单独排名位于接受池内。仅凭排序质量无法评估评审质量；校准、阈值、模型和目标结果均至关重要。

summary: Speech language models have expanded automatic speech recognition (ASR) from transcription to general speech-to-text generation. Yet existing benchmarks still assume a single ground-truth transcript per utterance, an assumption that struggles when models produce readable, formatted, or structured outputs. In this work, we introduce Grounded Generative Speech Recognition (GSR), reformulating speech recognition as generating semantically grounded text instead of a single transcript. We define a grounded reformulation space that characterizes all valid textual realizations supported by the input speech, and establish a four-level hierarchy of reformulation capabilities, including literal transcription, canonical reformulation, semantic reformulation and speech-grounded structuring. Based on this formulation, we present GSR-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate generative speech recognition systems beyond exact transcript matching. GSR-Bench covers diverse scenarios including refined meeting transcription, cross-dialect translation, context-aware speech understanding, and robustness under silent or noisy acoustic conditions. To address the limitations of word-level evaluation metrics, we develop a multi-dimensional evaluation framework combining speech grounding assessment and LLM-based semantic judgment, whose reliability is validated through human preference studies. Extensive experiments across representative architectures, ranging from conventional ASR systems to end-to-end Speech-LLMs, reveal fundamental trade-offs between transcription fidelity and generative reformulation ability. Our analysis further identifies critical failure modes, including acoustic hallucination, unsupported generation, and instruction drift, providing insights into the design and evaluation of future grounded generative speech systems.
title: From Transcription to Reformulation: Defining and Benchmarking Grounded Generative Speech Recognition
title_translated: 从转录到重构：定义并基准化基于语境的生成式语音识别
summary_translated: 语音语言模型已将自动语音识别（ASR）从转录扩展至通用语音到文本生成。然而，现有基准仍假设每段话语只有一个标准转录本，这一假设在模型生成可读、格式化或结构化输出时面临挑战。本文提出基于语境的生成式语音识别（GSR），将语音识别重新定义为生成语义上具有依据的文本，而非单一转录本。我们定义了一个语境重构空间，表征所有由输入语音支持的有效文本实现形式，并建立了一个包含四个层级的重构能力层次结构：字面转录、规范重构、语义重构和语音-语境结构化。基于此框架，我们提出了GSR-Bench，首个旨在超越精确转录匹配的全面生成式语音识别评估基准。GSR-Bench涵盖多种场景，包括精细化会议转录、跨方言翻译、上下文感知语音理解，以及在无声或嘈杂声学条件下的鲁棒性。为克服词级评估指标的局限性，我们开发了一套多维评估框架，结合语音语境评估与基于LLM的语义判断，其可靠性通过人工偏好研究得到验证。对代表性架构（从传统ASR系统到端到端语音-LLMs）的广泛实验揭示了转录保真度与生成重构能力之间的根本权衡。我们的分析还识别出关键失败模式，包括声学幻觉、无依据生成和指令漂移，为未来基于语境的生成式语音系统的设计与评估提供了洞见。

summary: Long-horizon LLM agents play an important role in solving complex and sustained tasks, with ever-growing interaction contexts. However, these accumulated contexts will raise substantial computational cost and obscure key decision-relevant evidence. Existing methods typically train external compressors or context-management agents to rewrite context as shorter hard-token sequences, but such external selection may not align with the LLM's evolving representation and is necessarily lossy. In this paper, we introduce Agentic Soft-Token Compression (ASTC), a training-free compression method using soft tokens within LLM agent for long-horizon tasks. Specifically, ASTC uses the model's native recurrent dynamics to determine the already absorbed information, leveraging the commonly-used hybrid Gated Delta Network (GDN)-attention. It then carries this information forward as agentic soft tokens while retaining exact values as hard tokens. The resulting compact sequence reduces later-layer computation and yields reusable KV caches, extending the savings across the agent's trajectory. Extensive experiments on long-horizon tasks show that ASTC matches or exceeds the uncompressed agent's accuracy with up to 50.68% fewer end-to-end Attention Pairs, while trained compressors require 15.4 to 103.7 times more Attention Pairs per successful task. These findings highlight agentic soft tokens as a model-native way to carry absorbed context forward as the task representation evolves.
title: In-Model Context Compression with Agentic Soft Tokens for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

title_translated: 基于智能体软令牌的模型内上下文压缩以应对长时序LLM代理
summary_translated: 长时序LLM代理在解决复杂且持续的任务中扮演重要角色，但交互上下文不断累积，导致显著的计算成本并模糊关键决策相关信息。现有方法通常训练外部压缩器或上下文管理代理，将上下文重写为更短的硬令牌序列，但这种外部选择可能与LLM演化的表示不一致，且必然造成信息损失。本文提出一种无需训练的压缩方法——智能体软令牌压缩（ASTC），利用LLM代理内部的软令牌实现长时序任务的上下文压缩。具体而言，ASTC利用模型固有的递归动态来判断已吸收的信息，借助常用的混合门控增量网络（GDN）-注意力机制。随后，将这些信息以智能体软令牌的形式携带前进，同时保留原始值作为硬令牌。由此产生的紧凑序列减少了后续层的计算量，并产生可重用的键值缓存，使节省效果贯穿整个代理轨迹。在长时序任务上的大量实验表明，ASTC在准确率上达到或超过未压缩代理，同时端到端注意力对数减少高达50.68%，而训练压缩器则需15.4至103.7倍更多的注意力对才能完成一次成功任务。这些发现表明，智能体软令牌是一种模型原生的方式，可在任务表示演化过程中携带已吸收的上下文。

summary: LLM-based simulated interviewees support interviewer training and the evaluation of mental health interviewing systems. Existing studies have primarily focused on improving human-likeness through richer patient profiles and behavioral modeling. However, human-likeness alone does not establish their reliability. Reliable simulation requires preserving profile-grounded clinical facts (informational invariance) while adapting disclosure and interaction behavior to the interview (relational adaptivity). To this end, we introduce PsyInterviewee, which separates a protected truth channel from a dynamic interaction channel and verifies generated clinical claims against the profile. Specifically, asymmetric write permissions allow dialogue context to update disclosure and behavioral states without authorizing new clinical facts; these states guide what profile-supported information is revealed and how it is expressed. In an automated evaluation of interactions between LLM-based interviewers and interviewees, PsyInterviewee achieves higher scores than four representative baselines on most metrics across both axes, as assessed by two LLM judges. Ablations suggest that the two channels contribute to clinical grounding and response modulation, respectively.
title: PsyInterviewee: Informational Invariance and Relational Adaptivity in Mental Health Interview Simulation

title_translated: PsyInterviewee：心理健康访谈模拟中的信息不变性与关系适应性
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型的模拟受访者支持面试官培训及心理健康访谈系统的评估。现有研究主要通过更丰富的患者档案和行为建模来提升类人程度。然而，类人程度本身并不能保证其可靠性。可靠的模拟需要在保持基于档案的临床事实（信息不变性）的同时，根据访谈过程调整披露和互动行为（关系适应性）。为此，我们提出PsyInterviewee，将受保护的真实信息通道与动态互动通道分离，并对生成的临床主张与档案进行验证。具体而言，不对称写权限允许对话上下文更新披露和行为状态，但不允许新增临床事实；这些状态指导哪些基于档案的信息被揭示以及如何表达。在对基于LLM的面试官与受访者之间互动的自动化评估中，PsyInterviewee在两个维度上的多数指标得分均高于四个代表性基线，由两名LLM裁判评估。消融实验表明，两个通道分别贡献于临床根基性和响应调节。

summary: Transformer-based language models have achieved remarkable success in automated short answer grading (ASAG). However, current methods in ASAG struggle to comprehend, reason about and evaluate complex mathematical answers involving symbols and formulas. These score-only methods fail to generalize across diverse responses and skill states associated with identical scores. Moreover, they ignore the potential upward bias introduced by generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) usage in assessing students' performance and knowledge mastery. To address these limitations, we propose AICG (AI-aware Cognitive-supervised Grading), a two-branch multi-task framework. The first branch combines RoBERTa-based regression, ordinal, and classification heads for individual-answer grading. The second branch uses an expert-designed Q-matrix to associate responses with assessed skills and jointly predicts G-DINA-derived skill mastery and learning gain. Through the shared encoder, these skill-level targets provide cognitive supervision for answer grading beyond score labels. AICG further uses a Gen-AI detector, trained through supervised contrastive pretraining followed by linear classification, to estimate assistance probabilities and convert them into reliability weights, attenuating unreliable cognitive evidence during learning assessment. We conduct experiments on 49,402 instructor-graded responses spanning 19 academic semesters. Relative to RoBERTa regression, AICG reduces mean absolute error (MAE) by 50.3% and improves quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) from 0.798 to 0.927. Ablations identify Q-matrix-guided cognitive supervision as the primary source of improvement, while AI-aware weighting further reduces overall MAE by 4.2% over the unweighted cognitive model and consistently improves MAE and QWK across the four most recent post-Gen-AI semesters.
title: Beyond Response Scoring: An AI-aware Cognitive Supervision Framework for Automated Mathematical Short Answer Grading
title_translated: 超越评分：一种面向自动数学简答评分的AI感知认知监督框架
summary_translated: 基于Transformer的语言模型在自动简答评分（ASAG）中取得了显著成功。然而，当前的ASAG方法难以理解、推理和评估涉及符号与公式的复杂数学答案。仅依赖分数的方法无法在具有相同分数但不同回答和技能水平的情况下进行泛化。此外，它们忽略了生成式人工智能（AI）使用可能带来的评估偏倚。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了AICG（AI感知认知监督评分）框架，一个双分支多任务架构。第一分支结合RoBERTa-based回归、序数和分类头，用于单个答案的评分；第二分支使用专家设计的Q矩阵将回答与评估技能关联，并联合预测G-DINA衍生的技能掌握度和学习进步。通过共享编码器，这些技能级目标为答案评分提供了超越分数标签的认知监督。AICG进一步使用一个Gen-AI检测器，通过监督对比预训练后接线性分类进行训练，以估计辅助概率并转化为可靠性权重，在学习评估中削弱不可靠的认知证据。我们在涵盖19个学术学期的49,402条教师评分回答上进行了实验。相比RoBERTa回归，AICG将平均绝对误差（MAE）降低了50.3%，并将加权二次kappa（QWK）从0.798提升至0.927。消融实验表明，Q矩阵引导的认知监督是主要改进来源，而AI感知加权在无权重认知模型基础上进一步将整体MAE降低4.2%，并在最近四个生成式AI后的学期中持续改善MAE和QWK。

summary: LLM agents execute tasks through repeated model calls over evolving histories of reasoning, actions, and tool feedback. Aggregate speculative-decoding metrics merge these distinct decisions, providing limited guidance on where draft supervision is needed. We present TraceSpec, a framework connecting trajectory evaluation with adaptive draft training. It combines dynamic execution with fixed-prefix replay and introduces TraceSpec-Traj, a corpus of 10,000 training states and 2,500 test states spanning browsing and software engineering. Analysis of five speculative baselines reveals that aggregate acceptance can rise with context length while declining within matched late browsing actions. Workload and phase further distinguish these trends, motivating supervision guided by trajectory conditions. TraceSpec trains on intermediate assistant turns and allocates a fixed prediction budget using state-conditioned estimates of prefix-aware acceptance gaps. Across three target sizes and two temperatures, it improves replay throughput by 12.5% to 22.6% over its DSpark base. Qwen3-4B ablations show that adaptive allocation increases accepted length by 3.3% to 10.0% over fixed full-turn supervision, with additional comparisons substantiating the roles of state conditioning and consecutive-token agreement. The resulting evaluation resources, trajectory findings, and training strategy connect the analysis of agent execution to practical draft improvement.
title: TraceSpec: Understanding and Improving Speculative Decoding for LLM Agents
title_translated: TraceSpec：理解与改进LLM智能体的推测解码
summary_translated: LLM智能体通过反复调用模型并基于不断演化的推理、动作和工具反馈历史来执行任务。现有的推测解码综合指标将这些不同的决策合并，对何时需要草稿监督提供有限指导。我们提出TraceSpec框架，将轨迹评估与自适应草稿训练相连接。该框架结合动态执行与固定前缀重放，引入TraceSpec-Traj数据集，包含10,000个训练状态和2,500个测试状态，覆盖浏览和软件工程场景。对五种推测基线的分析显示，随着上下文长度增加，总体接受率上升，但在匹配的后期浏览操作中却下降。工作负载和阶段进一步区分了这些趋势，促使基于轨迹条件的监督策略。TraceSpec在中间助手回合上训练，并使用状态条件化的前缀感知接受差距估计，分配固定的预测预算。在三种目标大小和两种温度设置下，其重放吞吐量比基础模型DSpark提高12.5%至22.6%。Qwen3-4B的消融实验表明，自适应分配使接受长度增加3.3%至10.0%，相较于固定全回合监督；额外比较证实了状态条件性和连续标记一致性的关键作用。由此产生的评估资源、轨迹发现和训练策略将智能体执行分析与实际草稿优化紧密联系。

summary: Stickers are widely used in social media dialogues to express affect, stance, and intent beyond literal text. Their meanings are often non-literal and context-dependent, making them difficult to handle with generic visual fusion or standalone captioning. We propose Sticker-to-Text Dialogue Reconstruction (S2TDR), a structured multimodal reconstruction framework that converts sticker turns into contextually appropriate textual utterances. S2TDR decomposes sticker interpretation into visual cue extraction, affective-intent inference, and context-aware dialogue reconstruction, using OCR text only as an auxiliary cue when available. The reconstructed dialogue can then be consumed by existing text-based dialogue models. Experiments on sentiment analysis, intent recognition, and dialogue summarization show that S2TDR generally improves multiple downstream models over direct sticker integration methods. Further analyses on component ablations, OCR-empty stickers, and reconstruction quality indicate that structured reconstruction provides an interpretable and effective way to integrate sticker semantics into dialogue understanding.
title: S2TDR: Structured Multimodal Reconstruction for Sticker-Aware Dialogue Understanding
title_translated: S2TDR：面向贴纸感知对话理解的结构化多模态重建
summary_translated: 贴纸在社交媒体对话中广泛用于表达情感、立场和意图，超越字面文本含义。其意义往往非字面且依赖上下文，使得通用视觉融合或独立字幕方法难以处理。我们提出贴纸到文本对话重建（S2TDR）框架，一种结构化多模态重建方法，将贴纸对话回合转换为语境恰当的文本表达。S2TDR将贴纸理解分解为视觉线索提取、情感-意图推断和上下文感知对话重建三个步骤，仅在可用时将OCR文本作为辅助线索。重建后的对话可被现有基于文本的对话模型直接使用。在情感分析、意图识别和对话摘要任务上的实验表明，S2TDR普遍优于直接集成贴纸的方法，提升了多个下游模型性能。对组件消融、无OCR贴纸及重建质量的进一步分析表明，结构化重建为将贴纸语义有效整合进对话理解提供了一种可解释且高效的方式。

summary: Fine-tuning improves a language model's performance in a target domain but can weaken its general capabilities. Existing methods often face a trade-off between general capabilities and domain specialization, making it difficult to preserve both. We introduce HyperRepair, a framework for recovering general capabilities while retaining domain specialization at only inference cost. To make recovery generalizable across models sharing a pretrained backbone, HyperRepair learns a hypernetwork from repairs trained on source models. The hypernetwork uses activation fingerprints that summarize changes from the pretrained backbone to generate a tailored Repairing Side Net (RSN), whose prompt-conditioned gate applies corrections selectively. This enables recovery on models from unseen adaptation domains without target-domain examples or additional optimization. We evaluate HyperRpair across two model families, 12 LoRA adaptation datasets, and 15 general benchmarks. On the default split, HyperRepair achieves 93.4% of the base models' average general score while retaining 99.5% of the fine-tuned models' average domain score.
title: HyperRepair: Recovering Forgotten General Capabilities of Fine-Tuned Language Models
title_translated: HyperRepair：恢复微调语言模型遗忘的通用能力
summary_translated: 微调能提升语言模型在特定领域中的表现，但可能削弱其通用能力。现有方法常面临通用能力与领域专业化之间的权衡，难以同时保留两者。我们提出HyperRepair框架，在仅付出推理成本的前提下恢复通用能力并保持领域专业化。为实现跨共享预训练主干模型的通用恢复，HyperRepair从源模型的修复训练中学习一个超网络。该超网络利用激活指纹（总结自预训练主干的变化）生成定制的修复侧网（RSN），其提示条件门控可选择性地应用修正。这使得无需目标领域样本或额外优化即可在未见过的适配领域模型上实现恢复。我们在两个模型族、12个LoRA适配数据集和15个通用基准上评估HyperRepair。在默认划分下，HyperRepair达到基础模型平均通用得分的93.4%，同时保留微调模型平均领域得分的99.5%。

summary: This paper investigates the Women-Are-Wonderful (WaW) effect in language-model blame attribution: a favorable bias in which women receive more positive evaluations than men. Using 11,270 interpersonal conflicts from r/AmItheAsshole, we construct matched counterfactuals that vary the gender of the person being judged (the original poster) and the person affected (the counter-party). Across four language models, gender changes a minority of verdicts, but those changes consistently favor women. The effect is strongly role-dependent. Making the original poster a woman reduces the odds of blame by 9--52%, while making the counter-party a woman multiplies them by 2.7--9.2X. Counter-party WaW also varies across conflict types, strengthening in communication and relationship conflicts and weakening in family conflicts. Exploratory probes suggest that counter-party gender can shift judgments of sympathy, reasonableness, harm and protection. WaW is therefore not just leniency toward women being judged: models also judge conduct more harshly when it affects a woman.
title: Language Models Show a "Women-Are-Wonderful" Effect in Blame Attribution That is Not Just Leniency
title_translated: 语言模型在责任归因中表现出‘女性皆美好’效应，这不仅仅是宽容
summary_translated: 本文研究语言模型在责任归因中的‘女性皆美好’（WaW）效应：即女性比男性获得更积极评价的有利偏见。基于来自r/AmItheAsshole的11,270个人际冲突，我们构建了匹配的反事实情境，改变被评判者（原始发帖人）和受影响者（对方）的性别。在四种语言模型中，性别变化仅影响少数判决结果，但这些变化始终有利于女性。该效应强烈依赖角色。当原始发帖人为女性时，被责备的概率降低9%至52%；而当对方为女性时，被责备概率则乘以2.7至9.2倍。对方的WaW效应在冲突类型间也存在差异，尤其在沟通和关系冲突中增强，在家庭冲突中减弱。探索性探针表明，对方性别可影响同情心、合理性、伤害程度和保护判断。因此，WaW效应不仅是对被评判女性的宽容：当行为影响女性时，模型反而会更严厉地评判其行为。

summary: Many automated decisions in education involve choosing from a fixed set of options: assigning a rubric score, checking whether an answer meets a marking criterion, or identifying the first wrong step in a solution. Generative language models are increasingly used to make these decisions, but their responses require parsing, longer outputs increase inference costs, and confidence expressed in words does not necessarily reflect the probability of being correct. We present EDU-Jev, a family of single-pass ("System One") decision models at 0.8B, 2B and 4B parameters. Given an assessment context and a question with predefined answer options, the model returns a probability distribution over those options without generating text. A pointer head scores a marker for each option, ensuring the predictions are restricted to the allowed choices. Training uses a single supervised stage with soft cross-entropy against the available target label distributions; calibration is assessed empirically. Across twelve education benchmarks, EDU-Jev 4B achieves an average accuracy of 67.6%, exceeding the strongest of five commercial decision APIs by 9.4 percentage points and the best open 4B decision model by 18.7 points. On four cross-domain education sets, it matches the strongest API, which remains ahead on general decision-making and reasoning tasks. The 2B model processes about 150 decisions per second on a single H100 GPU.
title: EDU-Jev Training System-One Decision Models for Education

title_translated: EDU-Jev训练系统：面向教育的单一决策模型
summary_translated: 教育中的许多自动化决策涉及从固定选项中进行选择：如评分、检查答案是否符合评分标准，或识别解题过程中的首个错误步骤。生成式语言模型越来越多地被用于此类决策，但其输出需要解析，较长的输出会增加推理成本，且以文字表达的置信度并不一定反映正确概率。我们提出了EDU-Jev，一个参数量为0.8B、2B和4B的单次通过（“系统一”）决策模型家族。在给定评估上下文和预定义选项的问题时，该模型直接返回这些选项的概率分布，无需生成文本。通过指针头为每个选项打分，确保预测仅限于允许的选择。训练采用单一监督阶段，使用软交叉熵对目标标签分布进行优化；校准通过实证评估。在十二个教育基准测试中，EDU-Jev 4B平均准确率达到67.6%，比五个商业决策API中最强大的高出9.4个百分点，比最佳开源4B决策模型高出18.7个百分点。在四个跨领域教育数据集上，其表现与最强API相当，但在通用决策和推理任务上仍落后。2B模型在单张H100 GPU上每秒可处理约150次决策。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can expose language models to misleading evidence in retrieved documents. We investigate whether increasing the number of mutually agreeing poisoned documents affects a model's ability to detect misinformation. We evaluate 200 randomly selected questions from SciFact (random seed 38), comparing contexts with one poisoned and six healthy documents against contexts with six mutually agreeing poisoned documents and one healthy document. For Gemma-3-12b, poison-detection rates decrease from 25% (50/200) in the minority condition to 10% (20/200) in the majority condition. Among the 38 questions with different outcomes across conditions, 34 change from detected to undetected, while only four change in the opposite direction (exact McNemar test, p = 6.04e-7). This pattern is consistent with a conformity-like response to a majority of mutually agreeing poisoned documents. Our results provide initial evidence of conformity bias in RAG-based misinformation detection: Gemma-3-12b is substantially less likely to detect poisoned claims when they dominate the retrieved evidence.
title: Language Models Show Conformity Bias in RAG: When the Majority Endorses a Poisoned Claim
title_translated: 语言模型在RAG中表现出从众偏差：当多数人支持被污染的主张时
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）可能使语言模型接触到检索文档中的误导性证据。我们研究了增加相互一致的污染文档数量是否会影响模型检测虚假信息的能力。我们在SciFact中随机选取200个问题（随机种子38），比较包含一个污染文档和六个健康文档的上下文，与包含六个相互一致的污染文档和一个健康文档的上下文。对于Gemma-3-12b模型，污染检测率从少数情况下的25%（50/200）下降到多数情况下的10%（20/200）。在38个结果发生变化的问题中，34个由检测变为未检测，仅有4个相反方向变化（精确McNemar检验，p = 6.04e-7）。这一模式表明，模型对大量相互一致的污染文档表现出类似从众的响应。我们的结果为基于RAG的虚假信息检测中存在从众偏差提供了初步证据：当污染主张主导检索证据时，Gemma-3-12b检测污染主张的可能性显著降低。

summary: When a language model invents a Qur'anic verse or hadith, it gives false authority to text that readers may treat as sacred. Existing Islamic hallucination benchmarks are largely Arabic and often closed-ended, while Bengali resources mainly study general-domain hallucination or factual knowledge. We introduce BILAL-BENCH, a 240-question expert-verified benchmark for open-ended Islamic-source fabrication in Bengali. It covers Qur'anic attribution, hadith, fiqh, contemporary issues, and adversarial false-premise prompts, and uses a two-axis rubric that separates source errors from assertiveness. We evaluate seven open-weight models from 1B to 120B on 1,680 double-annotated responses. Six of the seven models confidently fabricate on 79.3-95.3% of source-production questions, with no monotonic improvement from scale. Hadith provenance is the weakest category across models: only two of 315 responses are correct and correctly sourced. The two 8B BanglaLLaMA variants have similar confident-fabrication rates but different error profiles. Models vary far more in whether they withhold a claim they cannot support than in source accuracy: appropriate abstention or false-premise correction ranges from 6 to 46 responses across the benchmark, and does not track parameter count.
title: Do Open Language Models Invent Scripture? BILAL-BENCH: Benchmarking Islamic-Source Fabrication in Bengali
