title_translated: 开放语言模型会虚构经文吗？BILAL-BENCH：面向孟加拉语伊斯兰源伪造的基准测试
summary_translated: 当语言模型虚构一段《古兰经》经文或圣训时，会赋予读者误认为神圣的文本虚假权威。现有的伊斯兰幻觉基准大多为阿拉伯语且多为封闭式，而孟加拉语资源主要研究通用领域幻觉或事实知识。我们引入BILAL-BENCH，一个包含240个问题的专家验证基准，用于评估孟加拉语中开放式的伊斯兰源伪造问题。该基准涵盖《古兰经》归因、圣训、教法、当代议题以及对抗性虚假前提提示，并采用双轴评分标准，将来源错误与断言强度分开评估。我们对七个参数量从1B到120B的开放权重模型进行了评估，共分析1,680条双重标注的回答。七种模型中有六种在79.3%-95.3%的源生成问题上自信地进行伪造，且性能随规模扩大并未呈现单调提升。圣训出处是所有模型中最弱的类别：315个回答中仅有两个正确并正确引用来源。两个8B的BanglaLLaMA变体具有相似的自信伪造率，但错误模式不同。模型在无法支持的主张上是否拒绝回答的差异远大于来源准确性：适当的回避或虚假前提修正在基准中范围为6至46次，且不随参数量变化。

summary: Large language models have been shown to memorise and reproduce verbatim sequences from their training data, raising concerns about privacy leakage, intellectual property exposure, and the limits of generalisation. Recent theoretical work suggests that attention heads may contribute to this behaviour by functioning as associative memory mechanisms, with memorisation capacity scaling with the number of heads. At the same time, empirical work has shown that many attention heads are redundant and can be pruned with limited impact on downstream performance. Despite these parallel findings, the effect of pruning redundant heads on memorised-sequence reproduction remains unexplored. In this work, we demonstrate that zeroing out a substantial fraction of attention heads prior to inference can significantly suppress verbatim memorisation while preserving, or even improving, language modelling performance on the benchmark used to identify redundant heads. Evaluating GPT-2-XL(1.5B) on known memorised sequences, we find that pruning 729 task-redundant heads reduces the memorisation count by 91.5%, while improving WikiText-103 perplexity by 0.92. These findings suggest that attention-head redundancy can be exploited to mitigate memorisation at inference time, without retraining or modifying the training data.
title: Fewer Heads, Fewer Memories: Pruning Redundant Attention Heads Suppresses Verbatim Memorisation
title_translated: 更少的注意力头，更少的记忆：剪枝冗余注意力头抑制逐字记忆
summary_translated: 大型语言模型已被证实会记忆并逐字复现训练数据中的序列，引发隐私泄露、知识产权暴露以及泛化能力极限等问题。近期理论研究表明，注意力头可能通过充当关联记忆机制而促进这种行为，记忆容量随头数增加而上升。与此同时，实证研究也表明许多注意力头是冗余的，可在对下游性能影响有限的情况下被剪枝。尽管这两项发现并行存在，但剪枝冗余注意力头对记忆序列再现的影响尚未被探索。本研究证明，在推理前零化大量注意力头，可以显著抑制逐字记忆，同时保持甚至提升用于识别冗余头的基准上的语言建模性能。在已知记忆序列上对GPT-2-XL（1.5B）进行评估，剪枝729个任务冗余头后，记忆次数减少91.5%，同时WikiText-103困惑度提升0.92。这些发现表明，可通过利用注意力头冗余性，在不重新训练或修改训练数据的前提下，于推理阶段缓解记忆问题。

summary: Conversational RAG benchmarks such as MTRAG and RETECO evaluate retrieval and generation end to end: each system answers from its own retrieval, so abstention must be scored against whether each retrieved context is sufficient. A convenient shortcut reads sufficiency off the relevance judgments and treats a context without gold documents as unanswerable. We re-run the official baselines exactly and test this shortcut on RECOR (RETECO track~2) with four retrievers (nDCG@10 from .18 to .59) and three Qwen3 readers. Two open LLM judges and a panel of four small open models label each context by content, and a model of another family audits 250 contexts blind, with adjudication. The stronger the retriever, the larger the share of no-gold contexts that still contain the answer (28\% to 72\%) and the lower the shortcut's precision (.68 to .10; .70 to .21 under the audit). A reader agrees: Qwen3-4B answers 62--67\% of these false misses correctly, against 23--30\% of no-gold contexts judged insufficient and 1\% with no documents. In most false misses, the answer comes from a hard negative mined for the same question, another turn's gold or a neighbouring chunk of the gold page. On MTRAG, whose judgments come from annotators, precision drops from .72 to .50. Under the shortcut, answerability AUROC is up to .19 too low, and the best sufficiency detector appears to be a retrieval score that never reads the documents. We release code, runs and labels, and recommend scoring refusals against content labels, not the presence of gold.
title: Better Retrievers, Worse Labels: How Incomplete Relevance Judgments Distort Abstention Evaluation in Conversational RAG
title_translated: 更好的检索器，更差的标签：不完整的相关性判断如何扭曲对话式RAG中的回避评估
summary_translated: 对话式RAG基准如MTRAG和RETECO对检索与生成进行端到端评估：每个系统基于自身检索结果作答，因此回避必须根据每个检索上下文是否充分来评分。一种便捷的捷径是从相关性判断中读取充分性，并将无黄金文档的上下文视为不可回答。我们重新运行官方基线，并在RECOR（RETECO第2赛道）上测试此捷径，使用四种检索器（nDCG@10从0.18到0.59）和三种Qwen3阅读器。两名开放语言模型裁判和四名小型开放模型小组根据内容标注每个上下文，另一家族模型盲审250个上下文并进行仲裁。检索器越强，无黄金文档却仍含答案的上下文比例越高（28%至72%），而该捷径的精度越低（0.68至0.10；审计下为0.70至0.21）。阅读器也证实：Qwen3-4B能正确回答62%-67%的这类假遗漏，而对被判定为不足的无黄金上下文仅正确回答23%-30%，对无文档的情况则仅1%。在大多数假遗漏中，答案来自同一问题的硬负样本、另一轮的黄金内容或黄金页面的邻近段落。在MTRAG上，其判断来自标注者，精度从0.72降至0.50。在该捷径下，可回答性AUROC最高低估0.19，最佳充分性检测器似乎是一个从不读取文档的检索分数。我们发布代码、运行记录和标注数据，并建议将拒绝行为评分依据内容标签，而非黄金文档的存在。

summary: Human preferences change over time: an established preference may remain valid over time, become uncertain as context shifts, or be explicitly revised. Effective personalization requires conversational AI to adapt its response strategy to evolving preferences rather than relying on passive memory retrieval. We formalize this capability as adaptive personalization under epistemic uncertainty. A human preference study further confirms that people favor state-contingent response strategies as preference uncertainty changes. To evaluate whether language models mirror this adaptation, we create a multilingual benchmark spanning 250 personas, 5 languages, and 25K conversational turns that decouples strategy selection from response execution. Across eight closed- and open-weight models, we uncover a recognition-generation gap: models reliably identify appropriate strategies when selecting among candidate options, but collapse during open-ended generation, suffering a 35-46% drop in strategy calibration. Crucially, this failure is systematic: models default to exploit-first behavior, over-relying on existing preferences regardless of preference epistemic uncertainty. We show this failure is addressable: while prompting interventions fail, targeted training that supervises models' internal strategy representations toward state-conditional human preferences narrows the user acceptability generalization gap by a third on out-of-distribution personas and conversational styles.
title: Adaptive Personalization Under Preference Epistemic Uncertainty
title_translated: 在偏好认知不确定性下的自适应个性化
summary_translated: 人类偏好会随时间变化：既定偏好可能长期有效，也可能因情境变化而变得不确定，或被明确修正。有效的个性化要求对话式AI能够根据不断演变的偏好调整其回应策略，而非依赖被动的记忆检索。我们将其能力形式化为在认知不确定性下的自适应个性化。一项人类偏好研究进一步证实，人们更倾向于根据状态变化采用相应的回应策略。为评估语言模型是否具备这种适应性，我们构建了一个跨250种人格、5种语言和2.5万次对话轮次的多语言基准，将策略选择与响应生成解耦。在八种封闭和开放权重模型中，我们发现存在识别-生成差距：模型在从候选选项中选择合适策略时表现可靠，但在开放式生成过程中则严重退化，策略校准度下降35%-46%。关键的是，这种失败具有系统性：模型默认采取先利用现有偏好再探索的行为模式，无论偏好是否存在认知不确定性。我们证明该问题可解决：尽管提示干预无效，但通过监督模型内部策略表示向状态条件化的人类偏好进行针对性训练，可在分布外人格和对话风格上将用户接受度泛化差距缩小三分之一。

summary: Automated red teaming trains an attacker large language model (LLM) to elicit harmful responses from a victim LLM, but reinforcement learning can collapse attackers onto a narrow set of prompts when attack success is the only reward. Such a collapse of attack diversity can bias safety evaluation toward repeatedly testing near-duplicate attack patterns rather than the underlying harmful intents. Existing methods often trade off attack success or inference cost for greater content or strategy diversity. We propose CoFiBreak, a coarse-to-fine diversity reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that improves attack diversity while preserving strong attack effectiveness and low inference cost. The coarse reward broadens which strategies the attacker uses by encouraging strategies underrepresented within each GRPO group, while the fine reward broadens how those strategies are realized by discouraging reuse of the same personas, framings, and output formats after harmful-intent information is removed from prompt embeddings. Diversity rewards apply only to attacks that already exceed an effectiveness threshold, so diversity cannot be gained through ineffective attacks. Since both rewards are computed only during training, CoFiBreak also retains inference efficiency. Trained with Llama3.1-8B-Instruct as the victim, CoFiBreak discovers 1.6-2.0x as many distinct successful fine-grained strategies as the strongest baseline across frontier victims on HarmBench. It reaches 98.8% ASR@10 (attack success rate with 10 generations per intent) on AdvBench with the highest diversity score among all compared methods, which is 2.1x that of the strongest-attacking baseline. The resulting attacks transfer to unseen frontier LLMs, reaching 71.0% ASR@10 on AdvBench with the unseen victim Claude-Opus-4.6. The code will be released.
title: CoFiBreak: A Coarse-to-Fine Diversity Reward for Effective Multi-Turn Jailbreak

title_translated: CoFiBreak：一种用于高效多轮越狱攻击的粗粒度到细粒度多样性奖励
summary_translated: 自动化红队测试通过训练攻击者大语言模型（LLM）来诱使目标LLM产生有害响应，但强化学习可能导致攻击者在仅以攻击成功为奖励时陷入狭窄的提示集。这种攻击多样性的崩溃会使安全评估偏向于反复测试近似重复的攻击模式，而非底层的有害意图。现有方法通常在攻击成功率或推理成本之间做出权衡以获得更高的内容或策略多样性。我们提出CoFiBreak，一种针对组相对策略优化（GRPO）的粗粒度到细粒度多样性奖励机制，在保持强攻击有效性与低推理成本的同时提升攻击多样性。粗粒度奖励通过鼓励每组GRPO中代表性不足的策略来拓宽攻击策略范围；细粒度奖励则通过禁止在移除有害意图信息后重复使用相同角色、框架和输出格式来拓宽策略实现方式。多样性奖励仅作用于已超过有效性阈值的攻击，因此无法通过无效攻击获取多样性。由于两种奖励仅在训练阶段计算，CoFiBreak也保持了推理效率。以Llama3.1-8B-Instruct为目标模型进行训练，CoFiBreak在HarmBench上的前沿目标上发现的独立成功细粒度策略数量是最强基线的1.6-2.0倍；在AdvBench上达到98.8%的ASR@10（每意图10次生成的攻击成功率），且多样性得分最高，是最强攻击基线的2.1倍。所生成的攻击可迁移至未见过的前沿LLM，在未见目标Claude-Opus-4.6上达到71.0%的ASR@10。代码将公开发布。

summary: Fairness benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) are overwhelmingly English-born and American in their social categories; translated versions carry those categories into societies where they do not apply, and almost none fix their hypotheses before the models are run. We present Qistas (Arabic qistas, "the just balance"), a protocol for evaluating how LLMs treat the social, confessional, and regional constituencies of a society, portable across countries and instantiated first for Iraq. In its pilot form it measures only what needs no verdict on contested truth: procedural symmetry across matched counterfactual pairs, differential refusal, stereotype reliance under ambiguity, and terminological framing of documented events. Every measurement is paired by construction and analysed with paired machinery (sign-flip permutation tests, exact McNemar tests, template-clustered bootstrap intervals, Holm-corrected families), with a power analysis that states, before any data exist, the smallest effect each axis can detect after the design effect of template clustering. We release the authoring apparatus (a pruned 3x5 taxonomy with four cells closed by design, per-type checklists, a cumulative rulings log, a structural audit, and a human review notebook) and report its first field test: a semantic review of a 58-item seed bank in which 24 of 25 template groups failed at least one check. The defect patterns it exposed (evaluation criteria leaking into prompts, token-level swaps that break Arabic agreement, epistemically unbalanced pairs, single-theme refusal probes, unwritten dialect twins counted as coverage) are, we argue, general hazards of counterfactual fairness benchmarks. This is a protocol paper, not a results paper: no model has been evaluated, and the accompanying pre-registration commits the hypotheses, metrics, exclusion rules, and analysis plan that the pilot will follow.
title: Qistas: A Pre-Registered, Portable Protocol for Fairness Evaluation of Large Language Models

title_translated: Qistas：一种预注册的可移植公平性评估协议用于大型语言模型
summary_translated: 当前大型语言模型（LLMs）的公平性基准大多源自英语和美国社会范畴；翻译版本将这些范畴带入不适用的社会，且几乎没有任何基准在运行模型前固定其假设。我们提出Qistas（阿拉伯语qistas，意为“公正的平衡”），一种用于评估LLMs如何对待社会、信仰及地区群体的协议，具有跨国家可移植性，并首次应用于伊拉克。其试点版本仅测量无需对争议事实作出裁决的内容：匹配反事实对之间的程序对称性、差异性拒绝、模糊情境下的刻板印象依赖以及已记录事件的术语框架。每个测量项均成对构造并使用配对分析工具（符号翻转置换检验、精确McNemar检验、模板聚类Bootstrap区间、Holm校正家族）进行分析，并包含一个预先设定的统计功效分析，说明在模板聚类设计效应下各维度能检测的最小效应量。我们发布了作者工具包（修剪后的3x5分类体系，每类型检查清单，累计裁决日志，结构审计，人工审查笔记本），并报告其首次实地测试结果：对包含58个条目的种子库进行语义审查，25个模板组中有24个至少通过一项检查失败。暴露的缺陷模式（评估标准渗入提示、破坏阿拉伯语一致性的词级替换、认知失衡的反事实对、单一主题拒绝探测、未写明方言双胞胎被计为覆盖）我们认为是反事实公平性基准的一般性风险。本论文为协议论文，非结果论文：尚未评估任何模型，附带的预注册承诺了试点将遵循的假设、指标、排除规则和分析计划。

summary: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) and speculative drafters offer efficient language generation but are typically evaluated differently: CDLMs generate independently through iterative refinement, whereas drafters propose text for target-model verification and correction. We compare their architectures without verification, using LangFlow for CDLMs and adapting DSpark's Markov and recurrent-head architectures for standalone generation. All models are trained from scratch for unconditional, single-block OpenWebText generation at lengths 16, 128, and 1024, without target features or verification, using common preprocessing, backbone dimensions, and training-update budgets. We evaluate generation perplexity (GenPPL) with an external language model and distributional similarity to reference text with MAUVE. With default denoising steps equal to sequence length, LangFlow outperforms both DSpark variants on both metrics at lengths 128 and 1024, while DSpark-RNN leads at 16. A conditional KL analysis characterizes dependencies excluded by the Markov head's previous-token conditioning. Recurrent memory removes this restriction and improves both metrics, but the longer-sequence gap persists. Teacher probability matching further lowers Markov GenPPL without observed MAUVE gains. Increasing LangFlow's denoising steps at fixed weights improves both metrics at lengths 16 and 128, changing the length-128 ordering relative to DSpark-RNN. These results establish LangFlow's longer-sequence advantage under the evaluated budgets and highlight iterative full-sequence refinement as a route to improving standalone generation beyond gains from recurrent head memory.
title: The Generative Gap Between Speculative Drafter and Continuous Diffusion Language Model
title_translated: 推测性草稿器与连续扩散语言模型之间的生成差距
summary_translated: 连续扩散语言模型（CDLMs）和推测性草稿器提供了高效的文本生成方式，但通常采用不同的评估方式：CDLM通过迭代精炼独立生成，而草稿器则提出文本供目标模型验证与修正。我们在无验证条件下比较两者的架构，使用LangFlow作为CDLM，将DSpark的马尔可夫与递归头架构适配为独立生成。所有模型均从零开始训练，用于无条件单块OpenWebText生成，序列长度分别为16、128和1024，不使用目标特征或验证，采用通用预处理、骨干维度和训练更新预算。我们使用外部语言模型评估生成困惑度（GenPPL），并用MAUVE衡量与参考文本的分布相似性。在默认去噪步数等于序列长度的情况下，LangFlow在128和1024长度上均优于两个DSpark变体，而DSpark-RNN在16长度上领先。条件KL分析揭示了马尔可夫头的前一词条件限制了依赖关系。递归记忆消除了这一限制并提升了两项指标，但长序列差距依然存在。教师概率匹配进一步降低了马尔可夫的GenPPL，但未带来可观测的MAUVE提升。在固定权重下增加LangFlow的去噪步数，在16和128长度上均改善了两项指标，改变了128长度下相对于DSpark-RNN的排序。这些结果确立了LangFlow在所评估预算下的长序列优势，并强调迭代全序列精炼是超越递归头记忆收益的独立生成改进路径。

summary: Effective computer-use agents (CUAs) should seamlessly combine visual GUI interaction with code and terminal execution within a single policy. We present Mage-VL-Cowork, a 4B hybrid CUA trained from a general multimodally aligned checkpoint through an end-to-end, progressive five-stage curriculum across midtraining, SFT, and RL. To power this curriculum at scale, Mage-CUA-Forge replaces per-task agent construction with reusable, skill-conditioned generation workflows and application-specific preparers, synthesizing 293,806 desktop and web tasks across 6,915 skills while reducing recurring per-task expenditure by 82.6%. Rather than directly distilling a default teacher, we evolve the teacher harness and instantiate specialized CUA harnesses to yield high-quality trajectories alongside stage-specific supervision. Mage-VL-Cowork-4B finally climbs to 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified through different training stages with more efficient reasoning cost, achieving state-of-the-art performance at its parameter size and pushing forward the frontier of on-device intelligence.
title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
title_translated: Mage-VL-Cowork：从演化工作台学习混合计算机使用能力的完整训练配方
summary_translated: 高效的计算机使用智能体（CUAs）应能在单一策略中无缝结合视觉GUI交互、代码执行与终端操作。我们提出Mage-VL-Cowork，一个4B参数的混合CUA，通过从通用多模态对齐检查点出发，经过端到端、渐进式的五阶段课程（中期训练、SFT、RL）完成训练。为大规模支持此课程，Mage-CUA-Forge将每任务智能体构建替换为可复用、技能条件化的生成工作流和应用特定准备器，合成6,915项技能下的293,806个桌面与网页任务，同时将每任务的重复支出降低82.6%。我们并非直接蒸馏默认教师，而是演化教师工作台并实例化专用CUA工作台，以生成高质量轨迹并提供阶段特定监督。Mage-VL-Cowork-4B最终在OSWorld-Verified上达到66.0%的性能，通过不同训练阶段实现更高效的推理成本，在其参数规模下达到业界领先水平，推动了设备端智能的前沿发展。

summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) is becoming a mainstream paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs), as it improves training efficiency by updating the model as rollouts arrive. Recent work argues that group-wise sampling in GRPO does not naturally fit asynchronous RL training because rollout lengths follow a long-tailed distribution, and proposes Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO) to improve stability and off-policy behavior, especially on agentic tasks. However, SAO relies on a closed-source value model obtained from scaling value pretraining. In this paper, we analyze GRPO and LiSAO, our lightweight reproduction of SAO without the pretrained value model, on single-turn reasoning and multi-turn agentic tasks. We find that GRPO outperforms LiSAO on reasoning tasks, while the reverse holds on agentic tasks. Since the value model of LiSAO is not yet well trained , LiSAO lags behind GRPO substantially in early training steps. To address this issue, we propose Li$^{2}$SAO, which Lifts Light Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization with group-relative actor-critic bootstrapping: while the critic is cold, a group-relative advantage trains the actor and a group-centered return trains the critic, after which training switches to single-rollout GAE. Experiments show that Li$^{2}$SAO catches up with or surpasses GRPO in early training and further raises the later performance ceiling. Code is available at https://github.com/jd-cc-coder/Li2SAO.
title: Li$^{2}$SAO: Lifting Light Singl-Rollout Asynchronous RL Optimization via Group-Relative Actor-Critic Bootstrapping
title_translated: Li²SAO：通过组相对演员-评论家自举提升轻量级单轮次异步强化学习优化
summary_translated: 异步强化学习（RL）正成为大语言模型（LLMs）后训练的主流范式，因其在滚动路径到达时即可更新模型而提升了训练效率。近期研究指出，GRPO中的分组采样并不天然适用于异步RL训练，因为滚动路径长度遵循长尾分布，并提出了单轮次异步优化（SAO）以提高稳定性和离策略行为，尤其在智能体任务中表现更优。然而，SAO依赖于从价值预训练中获得的闭源价值模型。本文分析了GRPO与我们无需预训练价值模型的轻量级复现LiSAO，在单轮推理和多轮智能体任务上的表现。结果发现，GRPO在推理任务上优于LiSAO，而在智能体任务上则相反。由于LiSAO的价值模型尚未充分训练，其在早期训练阶段明显落后于GRPO。为解决此问题，我们提出Li²SAO，即通过组相对演员-评论家自举来提升轻量级单轮次异步优化：当评论家处于冷启动状态时，使用组相对优势训练演员，使用组中心回报训练评论家，随后切换至单轮次GAE训练。实验表明，Li²SAO在早期训练中迅速追上甚至超越GRPO，并进一步提升了后期性能上限。代码已公开于 https://github.com/jd-cc-coder/Li2SAO。

summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) achieve remarkable success on diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage language-based chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation. As a result, existing reasoning-augmented UMMs often fail to inherit the test-time scaling and fine-grained controllability observed in large language models. We attribute this failure to a fundamental modality mismatch: reasoning is performed in a discrete token space, whereas image generation operates in a continuous space. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Latent Reasoning framework in Continuous space (LARC), which alleviates the token-level bottleneck by reasoning over continuous hidden states. Specifically, the training framework consists of two stages: (i) curriculum supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and (ii) information-gain reinforcement learning (RL). First, the curriculum SFT stage gradually converts token-level reasoning into latent reasoning. Subsequently, the information-gain RL stage self-evolves latent reasoning without ground truth supervision. Experiments across diverse text-to-image generation benchmarks show that LARC consistently improves generation quality, prompt following, and compositional fidelity. Notably, LARC achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval with a 7%p gain over BAGEL and demonstrates clear test-time scaling behavior, outperforming token-based generation under both parallel and sequential test-time scaling strategies.
title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models

title_translated: 连续空间中的潜在推理：统一多模态模型的统一方法
summary_translated: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）在多样化的多模态理解与生成任务中取得了显著成功，但仍难以有效利用基于语言的思维链推理进行图像生成。因此，现有增强推理的UMMs往往无法继承大型语言模型所展现的测试时扩展性与细粒度可控性。我们将这一失败归因于根本性的模态不匹配：推理在离散的标记空间中进行，而图像生成则在连续空间中操作。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了连续空间中的潜在推理框架（LARC），通过在连续隐藏状态上进行推理缓解标记级瓶颈。具体而言，训练框架包含两个阶段：(i) 课程监督微调（SFT），(ii) 信息增益强化学习（RL）。首先，课程SFT阶段逐步将标记级推理转化为潜在推理；随后，信息增益RL阶段在无真实标签监督下自我演化潜在推理。在多个文本到图像生成基准上的实验表明，LARC持续提升了生成质量、提示遵循度和组合保真度。值得注意的是，LARC在GenEval上达到领先水平，相比BAGEL提升7个百分点，并在并行与串行测试时扩展策略下均优于基于标记的生成。

summary: AI answers require more than apparent correctness: reviewers need to inspect their recorded basis. We introduce the Knowledge Layer Model (KLM), an open, implementation-neutral specification for inference records with versioned epistemic assessments, evidence relations, and explicit unknowns. SEDIM, the knowledge and evidence architecture of Nage AI OS, is a reference implementation. We reference KLM v0.3 (repository tag v0.3.0). Empirical material consists of separate internal experiments, not end-to-end validation. A historical platform-domain routing benchmark reports 137/150 classifications across 15 classes (91.3%; nominal 95% Wilson interval 85.7-94.9%); the numerator is recovered from a rounded summary, and historical example membership is unverified. A native-model weight-path configuration yielded 0/15 successful answers in a corrected two-source test. A capacity-growth comparison could not establish a reliable effect because of a defective legacy scorer and missing original outputs. Lexical and scoped diagnostics each yielded AUC 0.008 for silent-versus-contradicted examples, below the registered minimum of 0.65. Legacy packing lost gold-containing text in 118/221 selected cases; repaired packing retained it in 221/221. These measure text presence, not answer quality. Python and TypeScript verifiers reportedly agreed on six checks per synthetic fixture; a separate production disclosure was not accepted. Restoration, re-derivation, human-rubric support, boundary isolation, and bounded-response evaluations remain proposed. Findings are internal and author-reported; historical observations are distinguished from later reproductions. Evidence visibility does not establish correctness, causal reliance, security, or regulatory compliance. Independent replication and a complete public audit package remain future work.
title: The Knowledge Layer Model (KLM): Evidence-Visible AI Output, Routing Diagnostics, and Negative Results

title_translated: 知识层模型（KLM）：证据可见性、路由诊断与负面结果
summary_translated: AI答案不仅需要表面正确性，还需让评审者能够审查其记录的基础依据。我们提出知识层模型（KLM），一种开放的、实现无关的推理记录规范，包含版本化的认识论评估、证据关系和显式未知项。Nage AI OS的知识与证据架构SEDIM是其参考实现。我们引用KLM v0.3（仓库标签v0.3.0）。实证材料来自独立内部实验，非端到端验证。历史平台领域路由基准报告15类中137/150分类准确率（91.3%；名义95%威尔逊区间85.7–94.9%）；分子值由四舍五入摘要恢复，历史样本归属未经验证。原生模型权重路径配置在修正的双源测试中未能成功回答任何问题（0/15）。容量增长对比因遗留评分器缺陷及原始输出缺失，无法建立可靠效应。词汇与范围诊断分别对沉默与矛盾示例的AUC为0.008，低于注册最低值0.65。遗留打包在221个选例中有118例丢失黄金文本；修复后全部保留。这些指标衡量文本存在性，而非答案质量。Python与TypeScript验证器声称在六个合成测试用例中达成一致；但另一次生产披露未被接受。恢复、重推导、人工评分支持、边界隔离与有界响应评估仍为待议事项。研究发现为内部报告，历史观察与后续复现相区分。证据可见性不等同于正确性、因果依赖性、安全性或合规性。独立复现与完整公开审计包仍为未来工作。

summary: When a language model is fine-tuned to follow instructions, or further pretrained on a new subject, it often gets worse at predicting standard web text. This is known as "forgetting." We ask whether this loss can be undone by simple, fixed adjustments to the model's final token predictions. Across 14 pairs of base and derived models, from 1B to 7B parameters, we fitted a fixed bonus or penalty for each token (a vocabulary bias), alone or together with a temperature. On text held out from correction fitting, the largest top-4K bias recovery estimate is under 10%, with loss conditional on the retained vocabulary. Combining the bias with a temperature recovers up to 36%. Models further pretrained on math lose the most and recover almost nothing. Finally, in a controlled simulation where a model is damaged at random, with no planted bias or temperature change, the bias-plus-temperature fix still recovers 29%. Most of the real-model loss increase stays out of reach of our restricted fits.
title: Less Loss, Fixed Weights: Logit Corrections for Forgetting
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code and data: this https URL
title_translated: 减少损失，固定权重：遗忘问题的对数校正
summary_translated: 当语言模型经过指令微调或在新主题上进一步预训练时，其对标准网络文本的预测能力往往会下降，这被称为“遗忘”。我们探讨是否可以通过简单的、固定的对模型最终token预测的调整来逆转这种损失。在14对基础模型与衍生模型（参数量从1B到7B）上，我们为每个token拟合一个固定的奖励或惩罚（词汇偏置），单独或与温度调节结合使用。在用于校正拟合的保留文本上，最大的top-4K偏置恢复估计不足10%，且损失条件依赖于保留词汇表。将偏置与温度结合，最多可恢复36%。在数学领域进一步预训练的模型损失最大，几乎无法恢复。最后，在一个模型随机受损的受控模拟中，即使没有植入偏置或温度变化，偏置+温度修正仍能恢复29%。大多数真实模型的损失增加仍超出我们受限拟合的处理范围。

summary: Linear attention scales linearly with sequence length, but its finite-state memory can limit long-context retrieval. In gated linear recurrences, memory retention depends on state decay, which is shaped jointly by gate parameters A_log and dt_bias and by input activations. In controlled Gated DeltaNet (GDN) experiments, both parameters remain highly correlated with their initial values after training, highlighting the importance of initialization. Therefore, we introduce Dual-Axis Memory Initialization (DAMI), which jointly configures these parameters before training. DAMI assigns geometric timescales across heads for varied retrieval distances and a low-high-low input-sensitivity profile across layers. A small activation sample calibrates the GDN-family implementation to match both behavioral targets without adding trainable parameters. Across GDN, KDA, GDN2, Mamba-2, and RWKV-7, DAMI improves average RULER-style retrieval accuracy by 5.29 to 16.71 percentage points over the corresponding random-initialization baselines. Performance on language modeling, commonsense reasoning, and 2K real-world retrieval remains broadly comparable to those baselines. Our code is available at https://speedai.com/research/dami.
title: DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention
title_translated: DAMI：门控线性注意力中增强长上下文检索的双轴记忆初始化
summary_translated: 线性注意力随序列长度线性扩展，但其有限状态记忆可能限制长上下文检索能力。在门控线性递归中，记忆保留取决于状态衰减，该衰减由门参数A_log和dt_bias以及输入激活共同决定。在受控的门控DeltaNet（GDN）实验中，训练后这两个参数仍与初始值高度相关，凸显了初始化的重要性。因此，我们提出双轴记忆初始化（DAMI），在训练前联合配置这些参数。DAMI为不同头分配几何时间尺度以适应不同的检索距离，并在各层实现低-高-低的输入敏感度分布。一个小规模激活样本校准了GDN族实现，使其匹配两种行为目标，且不增加可训练参数。在GDN、KDA、GDN2、Mamba-2和RWKV-7上，DAMI相较于对应随机初始化基线，平均RULER风格检索准确率提升5.29至16.71个百分点。在语言建模、常识推理和2K真实世界检索任务上的表现与基线基本相当。代码已公开于 https://speedai.com/research/dami。

summary: An agent that must call several tools to fulfill a request fails when the tool retriever omits any one of them, yet tool retrievers are mostly built and evaluated on queries requiring a single tool. We compare representatives of six retrieval structures (flat lexical and dense retrieval, LLM query decomposition, LLM-navigated hierarchies, server-then-tool matching, dependency graphs, and trained set-level retrievers) across two multi-tool testbeds: 345 AppWorld queries with expert dependency labels and 103 MCP-Bench tasks over 257 MCP tools. We measure completeness@k, the share of queries whose entire required tool set appears in the top k, alongside the LLM calls, tokens, and latency that each structure incurs at retrieval time. A motivating analysis on all 7,961 ToolRet queries shows that aggregate completeness mixes two regimes: completeness at 10 is .58 to .67 on single-target queries and .08 to .17 on queries with four or more targets, and the ordering of retrievers on single-target queries reverses on multi-target ones. Across the two testbeds, none of the compared structures that is untrained on the testbed and makes at most one LLM call per query completes more than 10% of AppWorld queries at k = 16. The two structures that do better incur different costs: a set-level retriever trained on 75 to 90 in-domain queries reaches .33 on AppWorld and .58 on MCP-Bench with no LLM calls, while an LLM-navigated hierarchy reaches .30 and .40 with a median of 31 to 38 LLM calls and about five minutes per query. Their failure modes also differ: the trained retriever mostly ranks the missing tools just below the cutoff, whereas the hierarchy finds the target API and stops before collecting its prerequisites. In a downstream check with the official AppWorld agent, tasks with a complete retrieved set succeeded 21 of 21 times, whereas incomplete ones succeeded 2 of 39 times.
title: Completeness and Cost of Retrieval Structures for Multi-Tool Requests in LLM Agents
title_translated: 大型语言模型智能体中多工具请求的检索结构的完备性与成本
summary_translated: 需要调用多个工具以完成请求的智能体，若工具检索器遗漏任一工具则会失败，但当前工具检索器大多基于仅需单一工具的查询进行构建和评估。本文在两个多工具测试平台（包含345个AppWorld查询及专家标注依赖关系、103个MCP-Bench任务覆盖257个MCP工具）上对比了六种检索结构（扁平词法与密集检索、LLM查询分解、LLM导航的层次结构、服务器后匹配、依赖图、训练过的集合级检索器）的性能。衡量指标包括 completeness@k（top k 中完整包含所需工具集的查询比例），以及每种结构在检索阶段产生的LLM调用次数、token消耗和延迟。对7,961条ToolRet查询的分析表明，整体完备性存在两种不同模式：单目标查询的completeness@10为0.58至0.67，而四目标及以上查询仅为0.08至0.17；且在单目标与多目标查询上，检索器排序顺序发生反转。在两个测试平台上，未在测试集上训练且每查询最多一次LLM调用的结构，在k=16时均无法完成超过10%的AppWorld查询。表现更好的两种结构成本差异显著：一个在75至90个域内查询上训练的集合级检索器可在无LLM调用情况下达到AppWorld的0.33和MCP-Bench的0.58；而一个LLM导航的层次结构则需中位数31至38次LLM调用，每查询约五分钟，达成0.30和0.40的性能。其失败模式也不同：训练过的检索器通常将缺失工具排在截断点附近，而层次结构找到目标API后即停止，未能收集前置依赖。在下游的官方AppWorld代理验证中，完整检索到工具集的任务全部成功（21/21），而不完整的任务仅2/39成功。

summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents interact with external tools through protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), producing tool-call traces that may expose behavioral signals about users. In this work, we systematically study the risk of user-profile inference from MCP tool-call traces, where observers infer user attributes from protocol-valid tool interactions without access to user conversations. We introduce PrivacyTrace, a benchmark containing 1,000 synthetic user profiles and 4,000 agent trajectories across four domains, generated with real MCP tools from 25 servers. Experiments with four mainstream LLM attackers show that tool-call traces enable a 26.25% attack success rate for profile inference, compared with 17.97% from prior-based guessing. Further analysis reveals that tool arguments and returned results provide the main trace-grounded evidence, while linking traces across sessions further amplifies profiling risk. These findings demonstrate that MCP tool-call traces can act as effective behavioral side channels for user profiling, motivating the development of privacy-aware mechanisms for agent-tool interactions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/AI45Lab/PrivacyTrace.
title: How Much Can Tool Calls Reveal About You? Privacy Leakage from Tool-Call Traces
comment: 24 pages, 12 figures, 8 tables, including references and appendices
title_translated: 工具调用能揭示多少关于你的信息？来自工具调用轨迹的隐私泄露
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过如模型上下文协议（MCP）等协议与外部工具交互，生成可能暴露用户行为信号的工具调用轨迹。本文系统研究了从MCP工具调用轨迹中推断用户画像的风险，即观察者仅通过协议有效的工具交互，无需访问用户对话即可推断用户属性。我们提出了PrivacyTrace基准，包含1,000个合成用户画像和跨四个领域的4,000条智能体轨迹，使用来自25个服务器的真实MCP工具生成。四项主流LLM攻击实验显示，工具调用轨迹使画像推断成功率提升至26.25%，高于基于先验猜测的17.97%。进一步分析表明，工具参数和返回结果是主要的轨迹依据证据，跨会话链接轨迹会进一步放大画像风险。研究结果表明，MCP工具调用轨迹可作为有效的用户行为侧信道，推动开发面向隐私保护的智能体-工具交互机制。代码与数据已公开于https://github.com/AI45Lab/PrivacyTrace。

summary: Task Vectors (TVs) provide a compact way to steer large language models, but they are typically treated as atomized directions merely extracted from hidden states, leaving their internal functional structure poorly understood. Motivated by prior work that decomposes in-context learning into Task Recognition (TR) and Task Learning (TL), we ask whether a single TV can likewise be decomposed into functionally meaningful components. We formulate a TR/TL-based decomposition from candidate-label unembeddings, separating each TV into TR, TL, and residual components, and try to optimize the TR and TL coefficients using Bayesian optimization for more effective intervention. We evaluate this formulation across multiple model families, classification tasks, and both instruction- and demonstration-based TVs. Across these settings, TR/TL-based optimization identifies intervention directions that outperform the original TVs. Although optimization over random directions can also improve performance, TR/TL-based search yields more reliable gains, particularly for instruction-based TVs. Moreover, isolated interventions on the decomposed components produce distinct logit-level effects that are consistent with their intended functional roles. Together, these results suggest that TVs are not monolithic steering directions, but can be decomposed into functionally meaningful components that support both interpretation and control.
title: Task Vectors Can Be Linearly Decomposed into Interpretable and Controllable Components
title_translated: 任务向量可线性分解为可解释与可控制的组件
summary_translated: 任务向量（TVs）提供了一种高效引导大语言模型的方法，但通常被视为从隐藏状态中提取的原子化方向，其内部功能结构理解不足。受先前将上下文学习分解为任务识别（TR）与任务学习（TL）的启发，我们探讨单个TV是否也可被分解为功能有意义的组件。我们基于候选标签解嵌入提出一种TR/TL分解方法，将每个TV拆分为TR、TL和残差组件，并采用贝叶斯优化来优化TR和TL系数，以实现更有效的干预。我们在多种模型族、分类任务以及基于指令和示例的TVs上评估该方法。结果显示，TR/TL-based优化所识别的干预方向优于原始TVs。尽管随机方向优化也能提升性能，但TR/TL搜索带来的增益更稳定，尤其在基于指令的TVs上表现突出。此外，对分解组件的独立干预在logit层面产生与预期功能角色一致的差异效应。这些结果表明，TVs并非单一的引导方向，而是可分解为具有功能意义的组件，支持解释与可控性。

summary: Bangla symptom-based disease prediction is commonly evaluated on a small, imbalanced structured benchmark containing many profiles that differ by only one or two symptoms. We test whether train-only asymmetric Bernoulli perturbation improves classification using 725 unique profiles spanning 85 diseases and 172 binary symptoms. Experiments use ten repeated real-profile holdouts and parent-grouped inner cross-validation. The 2 x 2 design separates augmentation from hyperparameter tuning, with exact duplication, random oversampling, class weighting, and SMOTEN as balancing controls. For Bernoulli Naive Bayes (BNB), the gain over tuned raw training does not withstand Holm correction, although BNB attains the highest mean accuracy (97.50%). The boosted-tree models benefit substantially: XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost improve by 18.10, 28.45, and 10.09 percentage points, respectively. A Hamming-distance audit places 91.0% of standard held-out profiles within one symptom bit of the training data. Accuracy decreases on a same-disease 1-bit-purged challenge; nevertheless, XGBoost and LightGBM retain large augmentation gains. We also evaluate robustness to missing and spurious symptoms and the faithfulness of BNB explanations. Overall, Bernoulli perturbation is useful for some model families, but benchmark accuracy should be interpreted together with template proximity.
title: Leakage-Controlled Structure-Preserving Augmentation and Template-Aware Evaluation for Bangla Symptom-Based Disease Prediction
title_translated: 泄漏控制的结构保持增强与模板感知评估用于孟加拉语症状驱动疾病预测
summary_translated: 孟加拉语症状驱动疾病预测通常在小规模、不平衡的结构化基准上进行评估，其中许多患者档案仅相差一两个症状。我们测试了仅在训练集上应用非对称伯努利扰动是否能提升分类性能，使用725个涵盖85种疾病和172个二元症状的独特病历。实验采用十次重复的真实病历留出测试和父组内交叉验证。2×2实验设计将增强与超参数调优分离，平衡控制包括精确复制、随机过采样、类别加权和SMOTEN。对于伯努利朴素贝叶斯（BNB），相较于调优后的原始训练集，增益在Holm校正下不显著，尽管BNB达到了最高平均准确率（97.50%）。而提升树模型受益显著：XGBoost、LightGBM和CatBoost分别提升了18.10、28.45和10.09个百分点。汉明距离审计显示，91.0%的标准留出病历与训练数据仅相差一个症状位。在同病种1比特删除挑战中准确率下降，但XGBoost和LightGBM仍保持较大的增强收益。我们还评估了对缺失和虚假症状的鲁棒性以及BNB解释的忠实度。总体而言，伯努利扰动对某些模型族有效，但基准准确率应结合模板接近度综合解读。

summary: Whether a language model was trained on a document matters for copyright, privacy, and benchmark contamination. Yet most membership-inference (MI) evaluations on language models collect members and non-members after the fact, so success may reflect distribution shift and failure is inconclusive. We re-ran OLMo 2 1B's official 50-billion-token mid-training stage, replacing selected training chunks with documents from 7,814 pairs matched on domain and difficulty. For each pair, a coin flip determined which document was inserted and which was held out. The run released by the Allen Institute for AI (AI2) from the same seed saw identical data everywhere else and serves as the counterfactual. One exposure raises a previously unseen document's likelihood on average but rarely identifies it. Using the counterfactual as reference, the reference ratio has an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.767 but, with one threshold across domains, catches 3.8% of members at a 1% false-positive rate (FPR). In contrast, 13 matched pairs give a paired test 80% power at the 5% level to detect training on a collection, given same-domain non-members and a close reference. A reference trained with another seed recovers 92% of the counterfactual's AUC advantage over chance, whereas reference-free attacks stay within 0.07 of chance when pooled over domains. The full official post-training recipe, re-run on both models, leaves 89% of the average effect. Even with a closely matched reference, substantial document-level variability limits individual membership inference. We will release the checkpoints, per-token log-probabilities, and the evaluation documents; the code is available at https://github.com/ali-bana/OLMo-Twin.
title: From Training Exposure to Membership Evidence: A Controlled Study of OLMo 2
comment: 20 pages, 11 figures. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 从训练暴露到成员证据：OLMo 2 的受控研究
summary_translated: 语言模型是否曾被训练于某文档，对版权、隐私和基准污染具有重要意义。然而，大多数语言模型的成员推理（MI）评估是在训练后收集成员与非成员，因此成功可能反映分布偏移，失败则难以判断。我们重新运行了OLMo 2 1B的官方500亿token中期训练阶段，将选定的训练块替换为来自7,814对领域与难度匹配文档的样本。每对中通过抛硬币决定插入哪份文档，另一份保留。由艾伦人工智能研究所（AI2）从相同种子发布的版本在其他所有方面完全一致，作为反事实对照。一次暴露平均提高未见过文档的似然性，但极少能识别具体文档。以反事实为参考，参考比率的ROC曲线下面积（AUC）为0.767，但在跨领域统一阈值下，仅以1%的假阳性率捕获3.8%的成员。相比之下，13对匹配样本可使配对检验在5%水平下达到80%功效，以检测对某一集合的训练，前提是同领域非成员和接近的参考。使用另一种子训练的参考模型恢复了反事实AUC优势的92%，而无参考攻击在跨领域汇总后仍与随机水平相差不超过0.07。完整官方训练后流程在两模型上重跑后，保留了平均效应的89%。即使有高度匹配的参考，个体文档级别的变异性仍限制了成员推理的有效性。我们将发布检查点、逐token对数概率和评估文档；代码可在https://github.com/ali-bana/OLMo-Twin获取。

summary: Looped language models can strengthen reasoning through repeated computation with shared weights, increasing execution depth without adding independent parameters. However, each additional pass increases training floating-point operations (FLOPs), making these gains more expensive to obtain. To address this cost, we propose UpLoop, a pretraining schedule that uses upcycling to train looped Transformers while exactly matching a standard dense baseline in final parameter count, total training tokens, and training FLOPs. Specifically, UpLoop begins with a shallow Transformer, progressively grows its depth by copying learned layers, and uses the computation saved early to support repeated execution of a shared middle block later in training. Experiments across model scales show improvements in language modeling and downstream performance, with the average score across 22 downstream tasks increasing from 22.99 to 27.52 at 1.3B parameters. These gains also extend to mathematical reasoning after supervised fine-tuning.
title: UpLoop: Training Looped Transformers via Upcycling at No Extra Pretraining Compute
title_translated: UpLoop：通过回收利用在无需额外预训练计算的情况下训练循环Transformer
summary_translated: 循环语言模型可以通过共享权重的重复计算来增强推理能力，在不增加独立参数的情况下提升执行深度。然而，每次额外的迭代都会增加训练浮点运算量（FLOPs），使得这些收益更难获得。为解决这一成本问题，我们提出UpLoop，一种预训练调度方法，通过回收利用在训练过程中实现循环Transformer的训练，同时在最终参数数量、总训练token数和训练FLOPs上与标准密集基线完全一致。具体而言，UpLoop从浅层Transformer开始，通过复制已学习的层逐步增加其深度，并将早期节省的计算资源用于后期支持共享中间块的重复执行。在不同模型规模上的实验表明，语言建模和下游任务性能均有提升，13亿参数下22个下游任务的平均得分从22.99提升至27.52。这些改进在经过监督微调后也延伸到了数学推理任务。

summary: Training interactive language agents from terminal outcomes poses three coupled problems: which task and state continuations to sample, how to assign delayed feedback to decisions, and how to aggregate token losses for multi-token actions. We present TSBPO, a tree-structured sampling-to-update paradigm that addresses these problems within one training loop. A likelihood-fitted Root/Branch allocator uses retained task and state evidence to target continuations likely to produce contrasting terminal outcomes under fixed rollout budgets. On the resulting replayed physical trees, trajectory advantages compare immediate sibling segments, while observation-group step advantages compare outcomes at matched task/observation states. The actor then sums clipped token surrogates over each complete response and normalizes across active turns, avoiding response-length averaging in the policy-gradient term. With a Qwen2.5-1.5B actor, fixed checkpoints obtain 97.79% seen and 96.64% unseen stochastic success on ALFWorld and an 81.07% per-episode success rate over six stochastic episodes for each of the 500 WebShop test goals. A WebShop step-term ablation yields 75.93% at the same update-100 evaluation; an ALFWorld aggregation comparison shows higher observed command validity with complete-turn weighting. These results support the evaluated training configuration on two interactive benchmarks.
title: TSBPO: Tree-Structured Branching for Policy Optimization in Interactive Language Agents
title_translated: TSBPO：面向交互式语言智能体策略优化的树结构分支方法
summary_translated: 从终端结果训练交互式语言智能体面临三个相互关联的问题：应采样哪些任务和状态延续、如何将延迟反馈分配给决策、以及如何对多token动作的损失进行聚合。我们提出TSBPO，一种树结构的采样到更新范式，可在单一训练循环中解决这些问题。一个基于似然拟合的根/分支分配器利用保留的任务和状态证据，针对在固定回溯预算下可能产生对比性终端结果的延续进行定向采样。在生成的重播物理树上，轨迹优势比较即时兄弟段，而观察组步优势则比较相同任务/观察状态下的结果。随后，智能体对每个完整响应求和截断的token代理值，并在活跃回合间归一化，避免在策略梯度项中对响应长度进行平均。使用Qwen2.5-1.5B作为智能体，固定检查点在ALFWorld上取得97.79%的已见和96.64%的未见随机成功率，在WebShop测试中，500个目标的每轮6次随机实验平均成功率达81.07%。WebShop步骤项消融实验显示，在相同更新频率下达到75.93%；ALFWorld聚合对比表明，采用完整回合加权可提高命令有效性。这些结果支持所评估训练配置在两个交互式基准上的有效性。

summary: Language models face two opposing concerns: monoculture, in which models err in correlated ways, and multiplicity, in which equally accurate models make conflicting decisions. The rise of reasoning models has complicated this debate: On the one hand, reasoning may increase model agreement if models anchor on the same salient features or follow similar reasoning paths. On the other hand, stochastic reasoning traces may introduce additional branch points leading to more diverse predictions. We resolve this tension by distinguishing reasoning as an intervention from reasoning as an observed behavior. We compare agreement under controlled changes in reasoning effort with agreement across observed reasoning lengths, measuring both against the agreement expected from model accuracy. Across nine models from two developers and three classification tasks, enabling reasoning increases agreement between models evaluated on the same individuals. Yet the individuals who elicit longer reasoning traces receive less consistent predictions across models. Both patterns persist after accounting for differences in accuracy. Asking models to reason more thus promotes agreement, while observing them reason longer signals disagreement.
title: Does Reasoning Make Language Models Agree?
title_translated: 推理是否让语言模型达成一致？
summary_translated: 语言模型面临两个对立的担忧：一是‘单一文化’现象，即模型以相关方式出错；二是‘多样性’现象，即同等准确的模型做出冲突判断。推理模型的兴起使这一争论更加复杂：一方面，推理可能通过锚定相同的显著特征或遵循相似推理路径来提高模型一致性；另一方面，随机推理轨迹可能引入更多分支点，导致预测更加多样化。我们通过区分推理作为一种干预手段与推理作为一种观察行为来化解这一矛盾。我们在控制推理努力程度变化的情况下比较模型一致性，同时测量在观察到的推理长度变化下的表现，均以模型准确率预期的一致性为基准。在来自两家开发者的九个模型及三个分类任务中，启用推理会提高在相同个体上评估的模型间一致性。然而，那些引发更长推理轨迹的个体，其跨模型预测的一致性反而更低。这两种模式在考虑准确率差异后依然存在。因此，要求模型进行更多推理有助于促进一致性，而观察到模型进行更长时间的推理则暗示了分歧。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has recently been extended to vision-language models (VLMs), yet its effectiveness remains limited for text-rich reasoning tasks. We highlight a key factor contributing to this limitation: models frequently arrive at correct final answers despite misperceiving visual information during intermediate steps. We define this phenomenon as Correct-but-Visually-Misgrounded Reasoning (CVMR). Because standard RLVR rewards only final-answer correctness, it fails to differentiate between properly grounded and misgrounded reasoning, reinforcing both equally. Through token-level analysis, we reveal that CVMR tokens exhibit distinct attention patterns that differ systematically from well-grounded ones. Based on this observation, we propose GRIT, a training framework that incorporates visual grounding into RLVR to mitigate the impact of CVMR. Furthermore, to address the lack of text-rich reasoning benchmarks that allow for systematic evaluation across text length and reasoning depth, we introduce GRIT-Bench. Experiments demonstrate that GRIT significantly improves both reasoning accuracy and grounding fidelity over existing RLVR methods.
title: GRIT: Gradient Masking for Visually Misgrounded Tokens in Text-Rich Reasoning
title_translated: GRIT：文本丰富推理中视觉误定位词的梯度掩码方法
summary_translated: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）最近被扩展至视觉-语言模型（VLMs），但在文本丰富的推理任务中其效果仍有限。我们指出造成这一局限的关键因素：模型在中间步骤误判视觉信息的情况下，仍能得出正确的最终答案。我们将这种现象定义为‘正确但视觉误定位推理’（CVMR）。由于标准RLVR仅根据最终答案正确性给予奖励，无法区分合理定位与误定位推理，从而同等强化两者。通过逐token分析，我们发现CVMR词元表现出与良好定位词元系统性不同的注意力模式。基于此观察，我们提出GRIT，一种将视觉定位整合进RLVR的训练框架，以缓解CVMR的影响。此外，为解决缺乏能够系统评估文本长度与推理深度的文本丰富推理基准的问题，我们引入GRIT-Bench。实验表明，GRIT显著提升了现有RLVR方法在推理准确性和定位保真度方面的表现。

summary: Understanding how code changes affect program semantics is a core aspect of code reasoning in language models. It is commonly evaluated by asking whether two programs are semantically equivalent, but a yes/no answer does not reveal whether a model knows which code change caused a semantic difference, or which sequence of code changes produced the modified program. We study two tasks that ask these questions directly, diagnosing semantic change and reconstructing sequences of code changes, alongside detecting semantic equivalence. We build SCRBench, 67,658 Python program pairs generated by applying sequences of code changes that preserve or alter program semantics, and evaluate five language models on a stratified subset of 4,500 pairs. Detecting semantic equivalence exposes weaker models, whose accuracy declines as changes accumulate, but the strongest models remain near the ceiling. Diagnosing semantic change reveals weaknesses that equivalence accuracy hides: a model with 94.71% equivalence accuracy diagnoses only 54.44% of semantic changes. Reconstructing sequences of code changes is much harder: the best model reconstructs the exact sequence for only 39.27% of pairs, and no model exceeds 1.11% when five changes are applied. High equivalence accuracy therefore overestimates how well models reason about the semantic effects of code changes.
title: SCRBench: Beyond Equivalence Checking for Semantic Change Reasoning in Code
title_translated: SCRBench：超越等价性检查的代码语义变化推理评测基准
summary_translated: 理解代码变更如何影响程序语义是语言模型在代码推理中的核心任务。目前通常通过判断两个程序是否语义等价来评估，但仅给出是/否答案无法揭示模型是否知道是哪个代码变更导致了语义差异，或哪一系列代码变更是生成修改后程序的原因。我们研究了两个直接回答这些问题的任务：诊断语义变化和重构代码变更序列，同时包含检测语义等价性。我们构建了SCRBench，包含67,658个由应用一系列代码变更生成的Python程序对，这些变更保持或改变程序语义。我们在4,500个分层子集上评估了五个语言模型。检测语义等价性暴露了弱模型，其准确率随变更累积而下降，但最强模型仍接近上限。诊断语义变化揭示了等价性准确率掩盖的弱点：一个等价性准确率为94.71%的模型仅能诊断出54.44%的语义变化。重构代码变更序列难度更高：最佳模型仅能对39.27%的程序对精确重构序列，当应用五次变更时，无模型超过1.11%。因此，高等价性准确率会过度估计模型对代码变更语义影响的理解能力。

summary: LLM-based theorem proving in Lean 4 has advanced rapidly, but provers are difficult to leverage newly contributed lemmas, because retrieval skews toward popular foundational lemmas, leaving the right premises buried among hundreds of thousands of candidates. Existing neural selectors rank candidates by semantic similarity, with three intrinsic limitations: frequency-skewed retrieval, isolated pairwise ranking, and degradation on out-of-distribution queries such as competition problems and informal language. Given that mathematics is structured by dependencies rather than similarities, we restore this signal to both the training data and the model. We curate two underused dependency resources. We conduct the first systematic mining of 53 Lean Blueprint projects, a previously untapped corpus of 3,805 manually curated informal+formal nodes that capture rare, research-level premises absent from Mathlib4. We further pair it with the extraction of comprehensive, typed, multi-level Mathlib4 dependencies. We then introduce DAPS, a dependency-aware premise selector with a structural neighborhood encoder, a group-level contrastive objective, and a Mathlib-then-Blueprint adaptation procedure. DAPS reaches mean Recall@32 of 89.25 on Mathlib4-Heldout (+11.41 over the strong selector LeanHammer), and maintains this lead on two out-of-distribution benchmarks. Further experiments demonstrate that DAPS premises improve theorem proving on miniF2F and IMO-ProofBench. Project page: https://daps-eth.github.io/.
title: DAPS: Dependency-Aware Premise Selection for LLM Theorem Proving
title_translated: DAPS：面向LLM定理证明的依赖感知前提选择
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的Lean 4定理证明进展迅速，但证明器难以利用新贡献的公理，因为检索偏向于流行的底层公理，导致正确前提被淹没在数十万候选中。现有神经选择器通过语义相似性对候选进行排序，存在三个固有局限：频率偏差的检索、孤立的成对排名，以及在分布外查询（如竞赛问题和非正式语言）上的性能退化。鉴于数学由依赖关系而非相似性结构化，我们恢复了训练数据和模型中的这一信号。我们整理了两个未充分利用的依赖资源：首次系统挖掘了53个Lean Blueprint项目，这是一个此前未被开发的语料库，包含3,805个手动标注的非正式+形式化节点，捕捉了Mathlib4中缺失的罕见研究级前提；并进一步提取了全面、带类型、多层次的Mathlib4依赖关系。随后，我们提出DAPS，一种具有结构邻域编码器、组级别对比目标和Mathlib-then-Blueprint适应流程的依赖感知前提选择器。DAPS在Mathlib4-Heldout上达到89.25的平均Recall@32（比强基线LeanHammer提升11.41），并在两个分布外基准上保持领先。进一步实验表明，DAPS选择的前提提升了miniF2F和IMO-ProofBench上的定理证明效果。项目页面：https://daps-eth.github.io/。

summary: Small-scale sentiment classification often suffers from data scarcity, which limits the generalization ability of the models. This study evaluates and compares the effectiveness of three data augmentation strategies: Easy Data Augmentation (EDA), back-translation, and contextual token substitution (nlpaug-style), with both traditional machine learning classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest) and transformer-based models (BERT). We perform a comprehensive empirical comparison with low-resource sentiment datasets by summarizing the results of recent studies and performing targeted head-to-head experiments. Our findings indicate that all augmentation methods improve performance. Contextual augmentation yields the most consistent gains for BERT models, while EDA and back-translation provide greater benefits for traditional classifiers. These insights help guide the selection of data augmentation techniques tailored to model type and dataset size, filling a critical gap in research on data augmentation for sentiment classification on small datasets.
title: Enhancing Sentiment Classification on Small Datasets through Data Augmentation and Transfer Learning
title_translated: 通过数据增强与迁移学习提升小规模数据集的情感分类
summary_translated: 小规模情感分类常面临数据稀缺问题，限制了模型的泛化能力。本研究评估并比较了三种数据增强策略的有效性：Easy Data Augmentation（EDA）、反向翻译和上下文标记替换（nlpaug风格），同时使用传统机器学习分类器（逻辑回归、随机森林）和基于Transformer的模型（BERT）。我们通过总结近期研究结果并开展针对性的对比实验，对低资源情感数据集进行了全面的经验比较。研究发现，所有增强方法均能提升性能。上下文增强对BERT模型带来最一致的增益，而EDA和反向翻译则对传统分类器更有利。这些发现有助于根据模型类型和数据集大小选择合适的数据增强技术，填补了小规模情感分类中数据增强研究的关键空白。

summary: Patients often arrive at brief, time-constrained clinical visits unsure of what to expect or ask, and millions of adults now turn to general-purpose AI chatbots to prepare beforehand. Yet whether conversational AI improves visit readiness remains unclear. We designed a large language model (LLM)-based visit preparation agent to guide patients before an appointment by gathering clinical context, setting visit expectations, providing relevant health information, building a prioritized list of questions for their clinician, and generating a summary. In a prospective consented randomized study in the Google Health app, 802 U.S. adults held 866 health-related conversations with the visit preparation agent (standard or concise variant) or a minimally prompted control chatbot built on the same LLM. The visit preparation agent significantly outperformed the control across blinded clinician evaluations and patient self-reports. In clinician reviews of completed sessions (n = 272), the agent achieved a 16.6% higher rate of comprehensive preparation (67.2% vs. 50.6%; P < 0.05) and an 8.5% higher rate of alignment with patients' health context (98.9% vs. 90.4%; P < 0.01), while maintaining high medical safety and appropriateness across all study arms. Patient post-surveys (n = 460) showed 16.8% higher visit preparedness (73.8% vs. 57.0%; P < 0.01), 14.3% higher confidence in knowing what to ask (81.4% vs. 67.1%; P < 0.01), and 12.0% higher overall satisfaction (74.0% vs. 62.0%; P < 0.05). Clinician and participant metrics were not significantly correlated, indicating that expert review and patient self-assessment capture complementary dimensions of patient-facing AI. These findings suggest that LLM chatbots can safely help patients prepare for clinical visits, with greater benefit when following a structured workflow, and motivate future studies on in-visit communication and clinical outcomes.
title: A prospective randomized study of patient-centered AI for clinical visit preparation
title_translated: 以患者为中心的AI用于临床就诊准备的前瞻性随机研究
summary_translated: 患者经常在时间有限的临床就诊中感到不知所措，不知道该期待什么或提出什么问题，如今数百万成年人转向通用型AI聊天机器人来提前准备。然而，对话式AI是否能真正提升就诊准备度仍不明确。我们设计了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的就诊准备智能体，通过收集临床背景、设定就诊预期、提供相关健康信息、构建优先级问题清单并生成摘要，指导患者在就诊前做好准备。在Google Health应用中开展的一项前瞻性、知情同意的随机研究中，802名美国成人与该就诊准备智能体（标准或简洁版本）或一个基于相同LLM的最小提示控制聊天机器人进行了866次健康相关对话。结果显示，就诊准备智能体在盲法临床医生评估和患者自评中均显著优于对照组。在临床医生对完成会话的评审中（n=272），智能体实现了16.6%更高的全面准备率（67.2% vs. 50.6%；P < 0.05）和8.5%更高的与患者健康背景的一致性（98.9% vs. 90.4%；P < 0.01），同时所有研究组均保持高医疗安全性和适当性。患者事后调查（n=460）显示，准备度提高了16.8%（73.8% vs. 57.0%；P < 0.01），知道该问什么的信心提升了14.3%（81.4% vs. 67.1%；P < 0.01），整体满意度提高12.0%（74.0% vs. 62.0%；P < 0.05）。临床医生和参与者的指标无显著相关性，表明专家评审与患者自我评估捕捉了患者导向AI的不同维度。这些发现表明，LLM聊天机器人可安全帮助患者准备临床就诊，尤其在遵循结构化工作流时效益更显著，并为未来关于就诊中沟通和临床结果的研究提供了动力。

summary: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle tasks ranging from everyday desktop activities to long-horizon professional workflows. Yet interfaces centered on screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions can impose a human-interaction prior, requiring repeated screen interpretation while leaving the computer's semantic and programmatic capabilities underexposed. We argue for exposing these capabilities and letting models choose and combine them. We introduce Hybrid Computer Use (HCU), a unified interface for general agents that combines three complementary channels: programmatic interaction through code and command-line tools, semantic interaction through accessibility (AX), and visual interaction through graphical user interfaces (GUI). Our HCU supports efficient AX interaction and guards against stale-state actions during channel switching. A supplementary HCU skill guides agents in selecting and coordinating channels to use the unified interface effectively. Our designed AX tools return compact observations, execute actions in batches, and report their effects as AX diffs, so the model needs fewer round trips. On OSWorld 2.0, HCU achieves the highest Partial and Binary scores among the compared systems. Analyzing agent trajectories, we find that all evaluated models improve with HCU yet allocate work across the channels differently and consistently outperform compared baselines in terms of both efficiency and task success, highlighting the value of unified computer-use interfaces that allow flexible channel selection and combination.
title: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
title_translated: 混合计算机使用：面向通用智能体的统一程序化、语义化与可视化接口
summary_translated: 计算机使用智能体正越来越多地处理从日常桌面操作到长期专业工作流的各种任务。然而，以截图和鼠标键盘操作为中心的界面可能引入人类交互先验，要求反复进行屏幕解读，同时使计算机的语义和程序化能力暴露不足。我们主张揭示这些能力，并让模型自主选择和组合使用方式。我们提出了混合计算机使用（HCU），一种面向通用智能体的统一接口，融合三种互补通道：通过代码和命令行工具进行程序化交互、通过无障碍（AX）进行语义交互，以及通过图形用户界面（GUI）进行视觉交互。我们的HCU支持高效的AX交互，并在通道切换时防止状态过期。附加的HCU技能指导智能体有效选择和协调使用这些通道。我们设计的AX工具返回紧凑的观测结果，批量执行动作，并以AX差异形式报告其效果，从而减少模型往返次数。在OSWorld 2.0上，HCU在对比系统中取得了最高的部分得分和二值得分。分析智能体轨迹发现，所有评估模型在使用HCU后均有提升，但各模型在通道间分配任务的方式不同，且在效率和任务成功率方面始终优于对比基线，凸显了允许灵活选择和组合通道的统一计算机使用接口的价值。

summary: Gated Delta Networks (GDNs) offer linear-time sequence modeling, yet long-context prefill remains costly due to dense intra-chunk computation, recurrent-state updates, and intermediate state storage. We introduce SparseGDN, a hardware-aware framework that combines structured intra-chunk approximation with input-dependent recurrent-event selection while producing outputs for every token. A block-adjacent solver reduces local Delta-solve computation, while a dynamic selector allocates recurrent-update budgets across head pairs. The GPU implementation materializes updates only for selected events and reconstructs token outputs using compact state snapshots and group-local interactions, reducing computation and memory traffic. We evaluate SparseGDN on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B across RULER tasks and context lengths from 4K to 128K. Retaining approximately 29% of recurrent events on average, SparseGDN achieves 1.50-1.94x GDN-core prefill speedups over native FLA kernels, including online selection overhead.
title: SparseGDN: Chunk Sparse in Linear Attention
title_translated: SparseGDN：线性注意力中的块稀疏化
summary_translated: 门控增量网络（GDNs）提供了线性时间序列建模能力，但长上下文预填充仍因块内密集计算、递归状态更新和中间状态存储而成本高昂。我们提出SparseGDN，一种硬件感知框架，结合结构化的块内近似与输入相关的递归事件选择，同时为每个token生成输出。块相邻求解器减少了局部Delta求解计算，动态选择器则在头对之间分配递归更新预算。GPU实现仅对选定事件材料化更新，并通过紧凑的状态快照和组内局部交互重构token输出，从而降低计算量和内存流量。我们在Qwen3.5-4B和Qwen3.5-9B上对RULER任务及4K至128K的上下文长度进行了评估。平均保留约29%的递归事件，SparseGDN在GDN核心预填充速度上相比原生FLA内核实现1.50-1.94倍加速，包括在线选择开销。

summary: In AI for Science scenarios, experimental design and method reproduction require retrieving protocols that satisfy multiple interdependent constraints, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of this capability. To address this gap, we introduce ProSearch, a benchmark for multi-constraint protocol retrieval in experimental science. ProSearch has three key features: (1) realism, with queries grounded in real experimental records and expert-defined templates; (2) complexity, with 60 experimental fields and their dependencies; and (3) diagnosticity, with 3-5 explicit constraints per query, including numerical and negation constraints. We construct ProSearch through LLM-based extraction, data-driven constraint selection, controlled query generation, and evidence-based relevance validation. The resulting benchmark contains 1,515 queries across six experimental science domains. We conduct extensive experiments on ProSearch with 19 representative retrievers and complementary analyses. The best-performing retriever achieves an average nDCG@10 of only 0.290, which improves to 0.474 with reranking. Structured diagnostic analysis shows that explicit constraint matching provides a strong ranking signal, while manual error analysis identifies joint constraint binding as a key bottleneck. ProSearch provides a testbed for systematically evaluating scientific retrieval systems.
title: ProSearch: Benchmarking Multi-Constraint Protocol Retrieval in Experimental Science

title_translated: ProSearch：实验科学中多约束协议检索的基准测试
summary_translated: 在人工智能用于科学的场景中，实验设计和方法复现需要检索满足多个相互依赖约束的协议，但现有基准缺乏对此能力的系统性评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出了ProSearch，一个针对实验科学中多约束协议检索的基准。ProSearch具有三个关键特征：（1）真实性，查询基于真实实验记录和专家定义的模板；（2）复杂性，涵盖60个实验领域及其依赖关系；（3）诊断性，每个查询包含3-5个明确的约束，包括数值和否定约束。我们通过基于大语言模型的提取、数据驱动的约束选择、受控查询生成和基于证据的相关性验证构建了ProSearch。该基准包含六个实验科学领域的1,515个查询。我们在19种代表性检索器上进行了广泛实验并进行了补充分析。表现最佳的检索器在nDCG@10上的平均得分仅为0.290，经重排序后提升至0.474。结构化诊断分析表明，显式约束匹配提供了强大的排序信号，而人工错误分析识别出联合约束绑定是主要瓶颈。ProSearch为系统评估科学检索系统提供了测试平台。

summary: Training-free expert pruning makes two decisions: which experts to remove, and what the layer computes when its router still selects a removed expert. Published methods change both at once. Holding the mask fixed, we compare replacement operators from three families on OLMoE, DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Moonlight, with Granite as a fourth router, using paired, multiplicity-corrected tests. The largest effect is a choice usually left implicit: the survivors' gate scale. On routers trained without top-k renormalization, renormalizing the survivors' gates, a common implementation choice, costs 0.8-8.5 points and reverses whether rerouting beats MoNE's mean-output replacement; on two routers trained with renormalization, the trained scale wins at 50% pruning. We introduce the tilted novice, a closed-form low-rank map of the pruned expert's input whose rank-0 case is MoNE's constant. At 50% pruning it adds 1.2-1.8% parameters and gains 3.45 and 1.37 points over the constant on OLMoE and Moonlight, stable across calibration draws and largely unchanged by 4- and 3-bit quantization. No operator dominates: trained-scale rerouting is best on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and a partial copy of each pruned expert is statistically indistinguishable from the tilted novice on two models. Evaluation can change conclusions: at 25% pruning MoNE's constant keeps 92-97% of dense multiple-choice accuracy but only 5-65% of GSM8K and 0-17% of code scores, and the calibration domain moves the mask 4-9 times more than resampling. We propose a five-item reporting checklist.
title: What We Keep of What We Forget: Replacement Operators and Routing Semantics in Training-Free MoE Expert Pruning
title_translated: 我们记住什么，遗忘什么：无训练MoE专家剪枝中的替换算子与路由语义
summary_translated: 无训练专家剪枝需做出两个决策：移除哪些专家，以及当路由器仍选择被移除专家时，层应如何计算。现有方法同时改变这两个方面。我们固定掩码，对OLMoE、DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Moonlight模型中的三类替换算子进行比较，并以Granite作为第四种路由器，采用配对且多重性校正的测试方法。最大的影响来自通常隐含的选择：幸存专家的门控缩放。对于未使用top-k归一化的路由器，对幸存专家门控进行归一化（一种常见实现方式）会损失0.8-8.5分，并逆转重路由是否优于MoNE均值替换的结论；而在两个经过归一化训练的路由器上，训练后的缩放在50%剪枝时表现更优。我们提出‘倾斜新手’，这是一种对剪枝专家输入的闭式低秩映射，其零阶情况即为MoNE的常数。在50%剪枝时，它增加1.2-1.8%参数量，在OLMoE和Moonlight上分别获得3.45和1.37分的提升，且在不同校准抽样下稳定，受4位和3位量化影响极小。没有单一算子始终最优：在DeepSeek-V2-Lite上，训练缩放重路由表现最佳；在两个模型上，部分复制每个剪枝专家的方案与倾斜新手统计上无差异。评估结果可改变结论：在25%剪枝时，MoNE常数保留了密集模型多项选择准确率的92-97%，但仅保留GSM8K的5-65%和代码任务的0-17%；校准域的影响比重采样大4-9倍。我们提出五项报告检查清单。

summary: Large language models increasingly generate structured outputs consumed by programs and downstream systems, where semantic correctness alone does not guarantee reliable execution. We introduce SERIAL-7, a Korean-English benchmark built around an executable verification framework for machine-verifiable generation across seven representations. Using 177 validated canonical artifacts, SERIAL-7 separates semantic derivation (Derive), constrained artifact generation (Realize), and cross-representation preservation (Preserve). Its 43 atomic representation constraints are paired with executable checks over format, structure, and task-specific semantics, enabling progressively stricter verification from representation compliance to full artifact validity. Across ten models, REALIZE-L3 HSR ranges from 42.0% to 93.9%, while Full Compliance exposes additional artifact-level failures beyond correct final answers and valid representations. These results show that reliable structured generation requires explicit, executable verification of how artifacts are realized and preserved across representations.
title: SERIAL-7: Deriving, Realizing, and Preserving Machine-Verifiable Outputs Across Representations
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding
title_translated: SERIAL-7：跨表示形式的机器可验证输出的推导、实现与保持
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地生成由程序和下游系统消费的结构化输出，仅语义正确不足以保证可靠执行。我们引入SERIAL-7，一个围绕可执行验证框架构建的韩英双语基准，用于跨七种表示形式的机器可验证生成。利用177个已验证的标准产物，SERIAL-7将语义推导（Derive）、受限产物生成（Realize）和跨表示形式保持（Preserve）分离。其43个原子表示约束与格式、结构和任务特定语义的可执行检查配对，支持从表示合规到完整产物有效性的逐步严格验证。在十种模型上，REALIZE-L3 HSR得分范围为42.0%至93.9%，而完全合规性暴露了除正确最终答案和有效表示外的额外产物级失败。这些结果表明，可靠的结构化生成需要对产物如何在不同表示间实现和保持进行显式、可执行的验证。

summary: Scientific data selection is typically driven by relevance or utility scores, providing limited insight into why a document is retained. We introduce SciGraphSelect, a reference-grounded framework for auditable scientific data selection. SciGraphSelect organizes domain-specific knowledge, reusable reasoning operations, and reference-attested relations into a typed knowledge--reasoning graph, then scores candidate documents using concept coverage, relation and path co-support, and directional alignment. To avoid over-interpreting document embeddings, rich relational structure is preserved on the reference side while candidate-side evidence is treated conservatively without assuming relation entailment. By exposing the reference-grounded evidence behind each selection, SciGraphSelect brings traceability to the upstream construction of scientific training corpora and complements downstream scientific verification.
title: SciGraphSelect: Auditable Scientific Data Selection through Knowledge--Reasoning Graphs
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: AI4Science
title_translated: SciGraphSelect：通过知识-推理图实现可审计的科学数据选择
summary_translated: 科学数据选择通常由相关性或效用评分驱动，难以揭示为何某文档被保留。我们提出SciGraphSelect，一种基于参考的可审计科学数据选择框架。SciGraphSelect将领域特定知识、可复用的推理操作和参考证实的关系组织成类型化的知识-推理图，然后使用概念覆盖度、关系与路径共支持度以及方向一致性对候选文档进行评分。为避免过度解读文档嵌入，参考侧保留丰富的关系结构，而候选侧证据则保守处理，不假设关系蕴含。通过揭示每项选择背后的参考依据，SciGraphSelect提升了科学训练语料库上游构建过程的可追溯性，并补充了下游科学验证。

summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly multilingual, distinguishing human-written from AI-generated text is essential for maintaining information integrity. However, research remains English-centric, with limited benchmarks for low-resource languages such as Hindi. To address this gap, we introduce SHAKTI, a large-scale Hindi benchmark covering four genres, eight LLM families, multiple prompting strategies, and adversarial transformations. We evaluate its quality through human annotation and analyze linguistic, grammatical, and sentiment-based differences between human- and AI-generated texts. Building on these findings, we propose TRIDENT, a round-trip translation-based detection framework with three variants: TRIDENT-S (static threshold), TRIDENT-D (dynamic threshold), and TRIDENT-C (logistic regression using multi-distance RTT features). TRIDENT leverages semantic consistency between original and round-trip translated texts to identify AI-generated content. Extensive experiments show that TRIDENT outperforms conventional and supervised baselines, with TRIDENT-S achieving the best overall performance. Further evaluations across seven languages, adversarial settings, and unseen LLMs demonstrate its multilingual applicability and robustness, while highlighting sensitivity to the translation model.
title: TRIDENT and SHAKTI: A Framework and Benchmark for Hindi AI-Text Detection
title_translated: TRIDENT 和 SHAKTI：印地语AI文本检测的框架与基准
summary_translated: 随着大型语言模型日益多语言化，区分人类撰写与AI生成文本对于维护信息完整性至关重要。然而，研究仍以英语为中心，缺乏针对低资源语言如印地语的基准。为填补这一空白，我们引入SHAKTI，一个大规模印地语基准，涵盖四种文体、八种LLM家族、多种提示策略及对抗性变换。我们通过人工标注评估其质量，并分析人类与AI生成文本在语言、语法和情感方面的差异。基于这些发现，我们提出TRIDENT，一种基于往返翻译的检测框架，包含三种变体：TRIDENT-S（静态阈值）、TRIDENT-D（动态阈值）和TRIDENT-C（使用多距离往返翻译特征的逻辑回归）。TRIDENT利用原文与往返翻译文本之间的语义一致性来识别AI生成内容。大量实验表明，TRIDENT优于传统和监督基线，其中TRIDENT-S整体表现最佳。进一步在七种语言、对抗性设置和未见LLM上的评估展示了其多语言适用性和鲁棒性，同时揭示其对翻译模型的敏感性。

summary: Retrieval-augmented generation is becoming agentic. A search harness writes queries, reads results, reformulates, and decides when to stop. This largely solves accuracy: a harness with only BM25/grep and MiniMax M3 answers 85% of BrowseComp-Plus and 91% on multi-hop FRAMES in our runs, without compiled or vector indexes. It exposes a context problem: an undisciplined loop repeats queries, rereads documents, and fills the window with unused passages. The missing layer is knowledge compilation: a configurable ingestion pipeline where LLMs enrich documents with context no chunk contains alone--navigation hierarchies with claim-evidence leaves, entity graphs, timelines, mind maps, ontologies, wikis, and memory. Compilation is not a better retriever: under a competent harness, structural artifacts gave no detectable accuracy gain on FRAMES, and a PageIndex-style outline degraded at scale. It is a supply layer. A navigation tree whose leaves are claim-evidence pairs--the mechanism we measure--cuts query tokens by 91% when evidence suffices and adds 1.9% when it does not, a 38% average reduction; this implies a 2% break-even sufficiency rate and a measured rate near 43%. A decision gate cuts latency from 140 s to 30 s, though substitution's token saving is bought with retrieval rounds and carries its own latency cost. Other artifacts--ontology, graph, wiki, timeline, mind map, memory--pay off in deployment (governance, integration, onboarding, temporal orientation, continuity) where accuracy benchmarks cannot see them. We describe RAGFlow's pipeline and harness (open source at https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow), which turns the loop into five disciplined stations and keeps the context entering the model the smallest sufficient set; together they form an agent-native database: a store that hands the agent compiled, governed context instead of a ranked list of passages.
title: Context as Infrastructure: Knowledge Compilation for Retrieval in Agentic Systems with Harnesses
title_translated: 上下文即基础设施：面向智能体系统的检索中知识编译与集成框架
summary_translated: 检索增强生成正逐渐向智能体化演进。搜索框架能够编写查询、读取结果、重构问题并决定何时停止。在仅使用BM25/grep和MiniMax M3的情况下，该框架在我们的测试中解决了85%的BrowseComp-Plus任务和91%的多跳FRAMES任务，无需预先编译或向量索引。然而，这种模式暴露了上下文管理的问题：无序循环重复查询、反复读取文档，并在上下文窗口中填入大量无关段落。缺失的关键环节是知识编译：一个可配置的数据摄入管道，通过大语言模型为文档注入单个片段无法承载的上下文信息——如带有论点-证据叶子节点的导航层级结构、实体图谱、时间线、思维导图、本体、维基百科和记忆系统。知识编译并非更优的检索器：在能力足够的框架下，结构性产物在FRAMES任务上未带来可检测的准确率提升；而类似PageIndex的概览结构在规模扩大时反而表现下降。它本质上是一个供给层。我们所测量的机制——以论点-证据对为叶子节点的导航树——在证据充足时将查询token减少91%，在证据不足时额外提升1.9%，平均降低38%；这意味着2%的盈亏平衡充分性阈值，实测充分性接近43%。决策门控将延迟从140秒降至30秒，尽管其token节省是以增加检索轮次为代价，且自身也带来延迟成本。其他结构（本体、图谱、维基、时间线、思维导图、记忆）在部署阶段（治理、集成、入职、时间定位、连续性）体现价值，这些优势无法被准确率基准捕捉。我们介绍了RAGFlow的流水线与框架（开源地址：https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow），将原始循环转化为五个有纪律的阶段，确保输入模型的上下文始终是最小且充分的集合；二者共同构成一种原生智能体数据库：一个提供已编译、受控上下文而非排序段落列表的存储系统。

summary: Iterative language-model optimizers refine prompts and programs by evaluating a candidate, showing a proposer model a sample of failing cases, and keeping revisions that improve performance. Recent work attributes the limits of this loop to narrow single-round reflection, introducing full-set error clustering, targeted minibatches, or larger proposer models so the optimizer sees more failure modes per step. Yet every existing evaluation tests these mechanisms exclusively inside lineage-preserving search, where each revision edits a surviving parent, leaving the contribution of parent inheritance confounded with the breadth of per-round feedback. Across 1,750 pre-registered runs spanning nine prompt and program synthesis benchmarks, we separate parent inheritance from feedback disclosure under matched evaluation budgets. We find that greedy parent inheritance drives the vast majority of optimization progress, outperforming seed-reset resampling even when seed-reset proposals receive a clustered summary of all failures in every round or use a larger proposer model. While full-set error clustering and diverse failure selection improve single-step rewrites from the seed and accelerate the opening rounds of search, sequential parent inheritance rapidly closes this gap as solved error modes are retained in the candidate and filtered from subsequent failure lists. Moreover, decomposing token expenditure in GEPA reveals that proposer reflection accounts for only a small fraction of total cost whereas validation and minibatch gating consume nearly the entire budget, showing that greedy parent inheritance over raw failures captures the gains of complex reflective loops at a fraction of their compute.
title: Lineage Is Memory: Parent Inheritance and Feedback Disclosure in Short-Budget LLM-Guided Optimization
