title_translated: 谱系即记忆：短预算下LLM引导优化中的父代继承与反馈披露
summary_translated: 迭代式语言模型优化器通过评估候选方案、向提议模型展示失败案例样本，并保留性能提升的修改来逐步改进提示词和程序。近期研究将此类循环的局限归因于单一回合反思范围狭窄，引入全集错误聚类、目标化小批量或更大规模的提议模型，使优化器每步能观察更多失败模式。然而，所有现有评估均局限于保持谱系的搜索环境中，即每次修改都基于存活的父代，导致父代继承与每轮反馈广度的影响相互混淆。在涵盖九个提示与程序合成基准的1,750次预注册实验中，我们在相同评估预算下分离了父代继承与反馈披露的作用。结果表明，贪婪的父代继承驱动了绝大多数优化进展，即使在种子重采样方案获得每轮失败的聚类摘要或使用更大提议模型的情况下仍表现更优。虽然全集错误聚类和多样化失败选择能改善从种子出发的单步重写并加速搜索初期，但随着序列化父代继承的持续进行，已解决的错误模式保留在候选中并从后续失败列表中过滤，迅速缩小差距。此外，对GEPA的token支出分解显示，提议模型反思仅占总成本的一小部分，而验证和小批量门控几乎耗尽全部预算，说明贪婪地继承原始失败项，即可在远低于复杂反思循环的计算开销下捕获其收益。

summary: Self-distillation methods for large language models with an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher already retain a history of student updates. Muon nevertheless stores a separate momentum buffer, increasing persistent training memory. We propose Muon with Reused Teacher (Muon-RT), which reuses the teacher-student displacement to eliminate momentum buffers for hidden weight matrices. We show that this displacement encodes an exponentially weighted history of applied updates and smooths temporally uncorrelated noise under a local model. Muon-RT removes its radial component, normalizes it spectrally, and mixes it with the current gradient after Newton-Schulz (NS) orthogonalization. Under explicit regularity and alignment assumptions, we establish linear contraction of an expected objective-gap bound toward a residual error level. With Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Muon-RT improves average accuracy over AdamW by 2.6 points with 42% less persistent memory, and over momentum Muon by 5.4 points with 27% less persistent memory. With Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) on Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, it improves average accuracy over AdamW by 2.0 points.
title: MUON-RT Reusing the Teacher's Trajectory for Momentum-Free Muon for LLM Self-Distillation
title_translated: MUON-RT：利用教师轨迹实现无动量Muon的LLM自蒸馏
summary_translated: 采用指数移动平均（EMA）教师的大语言模型自蒸馏方法已隐含记录学生更新的历史。然而，Muon仍需单独维护动量缓冲区，增加了持久化训练内存。本文提出Muon-RT（Reused Teacher），通过复用教师-学生位移来消除隐藏权重矩阵的动量缓冲区。我们证明该位移编码了应用更新的指数加权历史，并在局部模型下平滑时间无关噪声。Muon-RT去除其径向分量，进行谱归一化，并在牛顿-舒尔茨（NS）正交化后与当前梯度混合。在显式正则性和对齐假设下，我们建立了期望目标差距界线性收缩至残差误差水平。在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上的自蒸馏微调（SDFT）中，Muon-RT相比AdamW平均准确率提升2.6点，持久内存减少42%；相比动量Muon提升5.4点，持久内存减少27%。在Olmo-3-7B-Instruct上的自蒸馏策略优化（SDPO）中，相比AdamW平均准确率提升2.0点。

summary: LLM agents serve natural-language requests through tools, data sources, and other agents, and even simple requests often need several interdependent calls. Typically, the LLM picks these calls by trial and error, with no guarantee of an executable plan. We present Capability-Grounded Agentic Planning (CGAP), which instead reasons about what a request requires and what tools provide. CGAP compiles the tool catalog deterministically into a PDDL model, uses an LLM to turn the request into goals, and solves the model with a classical planner. Since tool outputs are unknown in advance, the model is abstract, tracking which inputs are available, not their values. During execution, an LLM adds entity-specific calls that abstract plans omit, and deterministic checks reject any that break the plan. Every argument is drawn from a cited source, such as a conversation span or an earlier tool response, and each requested result counts as delivered only after an LLM verifier checks it against the request. With three LLMs on ToolSandbox, ComplexFuncBench, BFCL multi-turn, and $τ^2$-bench retail, CGAP outperforms a standard tool-calling agent by up to 28.9 points.
title: Capability-Grounded Agentic Planning
title_translated: 基于能力的智能体规划
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过工具、数据源和其他智能体响应自然语言请求，而即使是简单请求也常需多个相互依赖的调用。通常，LLM通过试错方式选择这些调用，无法保证生成可执行的计划。我们提出基于能力的智能体规划（CGAP），转而推理请求所需的能力以及各工具所能提供的能力。CGAP将工具目录确定性地编译为PDDL模型，使用LLM将请求转化为目标，并通过经典规划器求解该模型。由于工具输出在事前未知，模型保持抽象状态，仅追踪可用输入，不关心其具体值。执行过程中，LLM添加抽象计划中遗漏的特定实体调用，而确定性检查会拒绝任何破坏计划的操作。每个参数均来自引用来源，如对话片段或先前工具响应，且每次请求的结果仅在LLM验证器核对请求后才视为完成交付。在ToolSandbox、ComplexFuncBench、BFCL多轮任务及$τ^2$-bench零售场景中，使用三个LLM测试，CGAP相较于标准工具调用智能体最高提升28.9分。

summary: Expert scientists excel at weighing empirical findings from multiple sources that vary in both statistical reliability and epistemic relevance. To what extent are language models, which are increasingly driving autonomous discovery systems, capable of such evidence deliberation? We introduce EDB-Bio, a scientific reasoning benchmark curated from real-world data in three biological domains: drug-perturbation transcriptomics, CRISPR screens, and human genome-wide association studies (GWAS). Each of EDB-Bio's 96k episodes presents a sequence of experimental results from published studies and asks the model to predict the probability that a target hypothesis is true. Out-of-the-box, open-weight and frontier models alike demonstrate systematic underconfidence and attain Brier scores comparable to a trivial base-rate forecaster. Post-training against strictly proper scoring rules significantly improves both calibration and discrimination. This calibration pays off downstream: in a sequential experiment selection task, our Ibis0 model is 2.5 times more efficient than the best frontier model. Throughout, quantifying evidence weights as Bayes factors reveals how models update their beliefs over time, whether they agree with expert biologists on relevance, and where they exhibit inconsistencies and biases. Our work extends calibration training and uncertainty analysis to a realistic scientific forecasting setting with applications to human cancer biology. We release all code, data, and trained models.
title: Do Language Models Know What Compelling Scientific Evidence Looks Like?
title_translated: 语言模型是否知道令人信服的科学证据应是什么样子？
summary_translated: 专家科学家擅长权衡来自多个来源的实证发现，这些来源在统计可靠性与认识论相关性方面各不相同。语言模型作为日益驱动自主发现系统的核心组件，能在多大程度上实现此类证据审议？我们引入EDB-Bio，一个从生物领域真实数据中构建的科学推理基准，涵盖药物扰动转录组学、CRISPR筛选和人类全基因组关联研究（GWAS）三个方向。EDB-Bio包含96,000个情景，每个情景呈现一系列来自已发表研究的实验结果，并要求模型预测目标假说成立的概率。未经微调的开放权重模型与前沿模型均表现出系统性低估，其Brier得分接近于仅依赖基础率的朴素预测器。在严格正确评分规则下的后训练显著提升了校准度与区分度。这种校准在下游任务中产生实际效益：在顺序实验选择任务中，我们的Ibis0模型效率是最佳前沿模型的2.5倍。在整个分析中，通过贝叶斯因子量化证据权重，揭示了模型如何随时间更新信念，是否与生物学家在相关性判断上达成一致，以及在何处存在不一致与偏差。本工作将校准训练与不确定性分析拓展至具有现实意义的科学预测场景，应用于人类癌症生物学。我们公开发布所有代码、数据与训练模型。

summary: In multi-task settings, combining multiple modalities allows task representations to draw on signals that a single modality alone would not capture. However, individual tasks may depend disproportionately on particular modalities, a structure that conventional fusion-based architectures do not model explicitly, instead enforcing a unified representation space. Consequently, a task's gradients can affect parameters tied to modalities it barely relies on, leaving features that compromise between competing demands. Although prior work has explored task-weighting and loss-balancing strategies, their effectiveness is limited by the absence of explicit modality separation, preventing models from optimising each modality according to its task-specific importance. To address these limitations, we propose MOSAIC (MOdality-Separated Architecture with Inter-modal Cross-attention), which preserves unimodal representations while enabling controlled interaction between them, and uses modality-specific losses to route gradients to their corresponding partitions. On the Corpus of Everyday Japanese Conversation (CEJC), MOSAIC improves average macro-F1 by 7.4 points across four tasks with a 72% reduction in backbone parameters relative to a fusion-based baseline. Our results demonstrate that modality partitioning yields consistent gains across tasks while requiring far fewer backbone parameters than a fusion-based design.
title: MOSAIC: Addressing Disproportionate Task-Modality Dependencies via Modality-Partitioned Gradient Routing
title_translated: MOSAIC：通过模态分区梯度路由解决任务-模态依赖不均衡问题
summary_translated: 在多任务场景中，融合多种模态可使任务表示利用单一模态无法捕捉的信号。然而，不同任务对特定模态的依赖程度可能不均衡，而传统基于融合的架构并未显式建模这一结构，而是强制统一的表征空间。因此，一个任务的梯度可能影响其几乎不依赖的模态所关联的参数，导致特征在相互竞争的需求间妥协。尽管先前工作探索了任务加权和损失平衡策略，但其效果受限于缺乏显式的模态分离，使得模型无法根据任务特异性重要性优化各模态。为解决这些局限，我们提出MOSAIC（具有跨模态交叉注意力的模态分离架构），在保留单模态表征的同时，实现可控的模态间交互，并使用模态特定损失将梯度路由至对应分区。在日常日语对话语料库（CEJC）上，MOSAIC在四项任务上的平均宏F1提升7.4分，同时相比基于融合的基线减少了72%的主干参数量。结果表明，模态分区在各类任务中均带来稳定增益，且所需主干参数远少于融合设计。

summary: Good decisions often require considering how outcomes will feel. Yet large language models (LLMs) increasingly enter decision workflows, despite little being known about how they map outcomes to feelings or use those mappings in choice. We tested how LLMs anticipated gambling or stock-trading outcomes would feel and whether they incorporated these ratings into choice. When outcomes were rated in isolation, ratings exhibited diminishing sensitivity to magnitude, resembling human value functions; but models rated gains more intensely than equivalent losses, an inversion of canonical loss aversion we call silicon gain amplification. When outcomes were rated together, enabling direct comparison, ratings linearised. In choice, the gain-loss asymmetry largely disappeared, and models' own ratings did not reliably explain their choices better than monetary utility did. These findings reveal malleable mappings from outcomes to affect, raising questions about whether and how agentic LLMs should incorporate anticipated feelings into decisions.
title: The psychophysics of affect in large language models

title_translated: 大语言模型中的情感心理物理学
summary_translated: 良好的决策往往需要考虑结果带来的感受。然而，大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地进入决策流程，尽管对其如何将结果映射到情感以及如何利用这些映射进行选择仍知之甚少。我们测试了LLMs对赌博或股票交易结果的情感预期，以及它们是否将这些评分纳入决策。当结果单独评估时，评分表现出对幅度的递减敏感性，类似于人类的价值函数；但模型对收益的评分强度高于等量损失，这种现象与经典的损失厌恶相反，我们称之为‘硅基收益放大’。当结果共同评估以支持直接比较时，评分趋于线性化。在决策中，收益与损失的不对称性基本消失，且模型自身的评分并不能比货币效用更可靠地解释其选择。这些发现揭示了从结果到情感的可塑性映射，引发了关于代理型LLMs应如何以及是否应在决策中纳入预期情感的疑问。

summary: Generative audio systems can produce large libraries of personalized bedtime content, but ordinary media objectives (retention, completion, and novelty) are poorly aligned with the goal of supporting a transition toward sleep. Direct evidence for narrated bedtime audio in adults is mixed, and a recent active-controlled trial did not support such audio as a standalone treatment for sleep disturbance. We translate this uncertain evidence into conservative engineering requirements and present a multilingual pipeline for generating and narrating low-arousal sleep stories. The implemented prototype separates deterministic planning from large language model generation, represents content and delivery parameters explicitly, shapes each script through a four-phase attention taper, validates structural and lexical constraints, performs a bounded error-aware retry, and quarantines unresolved outputs. Provider-agnostic text-to-speech synthesis is followed by paragraph-aware joining, two-pass loudness normalization, and a publication gate that re-measures the saved, encoded file against fixed loudness, loudness-range, and true-peak limits. The product data model records stop position, replay, early abandonment, and completion while treating these events as ambiguous behavioral proxies rather than clinical outcomes. We contribute an evidence-to-requirement mapping, a traceable guardrail architecture with explicit acceptance thresholds, technical evaluation criteria, and a prospective protocol for testing sleep-onset effects. No clinical efficacy is claimed; the system is positioned as a relaxation and attentional-support tool whose benefit and possible reliance must be evaluated empirically.
title: Nedimo: An Evidence-Grounded Multilingual Pipeline for AI-Generated Sleep Stories
title_translated: Nedimo：一种基于证据的多语言AI生成助眠故事流水线
summary_translated: 生成式音频系统可以大规模生产个性化睡前内容，但常规媒体目标（留存率、完成度和新颖性）与促进入睡过渡的目标严重不符。针对成人叙述式睡前音频的直接证据尚不明确，最近一项对照试验也未支持此类音频作为独立治疗手段用于睡眠障碍。我们将这种不确定的证据转化为保守的工程要求，并提出一种多语言流水线，用于生成和朗读低唤醒度的助眠故事。该原型实现将确定性规划与大语言模型生成分离，显式表示内容与交付参数，通过四阶段注意力衰减塑造每个脚本，验证结构与词汇约束，执行有界错误感知重试，并隔离未解决输出。采用无提供商依赖的文本转语音合成后，进行段落感知拼接、两轮音量归一化，并通过发布门控重新测量保存的编码文件，确保符合固定音量、音量范围和真实峰值限制。产品数据模型记录停止位置、重播、提前放弃和完成情况，但将这些事件视为模糊的行为代理而非临床结果。我们贡献了从证据到需求的映射、可追溯的护栏架构及显式接受阈值、技术评估标准，以及前瞻性测试入睡效应的协议。本系统不声称临床有效性；定位为一种放松与注意力支持工具，其效益与潜在依赖性需通过实证评估。

summary: The bottleneck of attention mechanisms, which are the fundamental building block of modern language models, is their quadratic complexity in terms of context size. There has thus been an increasing interest in the compression of the context, also called KV-cache compression. In this article, we consider the problem of compressing the context of attention mechanisms by first formulating it in the Hilbert space associated with its kernel. In this formalism, attention can be represented as the ratio of two linear maps whose interpolant is also the ratio of interpolants, this allows us to consider the interpolation of the linear maps directly. We thus introduce two novel KV-cache compression methods which we call GAIM and Q-DAIM, based on the Generalized Empirical Interpolation Method (GEIM) and the Q-Discrete Empirical Interpolation Method (Q-DEIM), respectively. As the cost of these methods is quadratic in terms of context length, we propose surrogate models based on the Taylor series, the Performer and the Random Fourier Features method which allow the compression to be done in linear time. Finally, we extend this result to the streaming attention setting, providing new methods which allow one to penalize the selection of interpolation nodes based on the previously interpolated context and to update the previous interpolation based on new information. We then provide numerical results on the convergence of the residuals and the output error in future queries and preliminary results on the LongBench-E benchmark showing performance comparable to the state-of-the-art methods. These experiments suggest that the range revealed by our Q-DAIM method could help identify where information is concentrated in the KV cache, thus enabling an efficient compression.
title: Kernel-based Interpolatory Methods for Context Compression of Attention Mechanisms
title_translated: 基于核函数的插值方法用于注意力机制的上下文压缩
summary_translated: 注意力机制是现代语言模型的基本构建模块，其瓶颈在于其复杂度随上下文长度呈二次增长。因此，对上下文压缩（即KV缓存压缩）的兴趣日益增加。本文首先将注意力机制的上下文压缩问题形式化为与其核函数相关的希尔伯特空间中的问题。在此形式下，注意力可表示为两个线性映射之比，其插值亦为插值之比，从而允许直接对线性映射进行插值。为此，我们提出了两种新型KV缓存压缩方法，分别称为GAIM和Q-DAIM，分别基于广义经验插值法（GEIM）和Q-离散经验插值法（Q-DEIM）。由于这些方法的成本随上下文长度呈二次增长，我们进一步提出了基于泰勒级数、Performer和随机傅里叶特征的方法作为替代模型，使压缩可在线性时间内完成。最后，我们将该方法扩展至流式注意力场景，提出新方法以根据先前插值的上下文惩罚插值节点的选择，并基于新信息更新之前的插值。我们在LongBench-E基准上提供了数值结果，展示了残差收敛性和未来查询输出误差的表现，初步结果表明性能可媲美当前最先进方法。这些实验表明，我们的Q-DAIM方法所揭示的范围有助于识别KV缓存中信息集中区域，从而实现高效压缩。

summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model agents by sampling and selecting among multiple candidate trajectories, but common realizations assume that these trajectories can be executed in parallel. This assumption breaks in realistic deployments, where enterprise workspaces and cloud services are shared and persistent, costly or infeasible to replicate, and actions may introduce irreversible side effects or cross-trajectory interference. Existing generative world models avoid direct execution, but typically compress environment state into a single prompt, limiting their ability to reliably simulate transitions under partial observability. Instead, we introduce Agentic World Modeling (AWM), which reformulates next-observation prediction as a multi-turn evidence-acquisition task. For each hypothetical action, an agentic simulator adaptively queries the real environment through safe read-only interfaces, reasons over the returned evidence, and uses executable computation to construct the resulting observation without mutating shared state. Integrated with trajectory-level TTS, AWM enables parallel exploration over a single shared environment. Across $τ$-bench, AppWorld, and OfficeBench, AWM outperforms a single-shot simulation baseline by 40.07% on average, and surpasses a trained world-model baseline by 12.36% on average. These results establish interactive, read-grounded simulation as a practical foundation for safe and scalable agentic test-time scaling in shared, non-resettable environments.
title: Agentic World Modeling for Agent Test-time Scaling without Environment Replica
title_translated: 无需环境复刻的代理测试时扩展中的代理世界建模
summary_translated: 测试时扩展（TTS）通过采样和选择多个候选轨迹来提升大语言模型代理的性能，但常见实现假设这些轨迹可并行执行。这一假设在现实部署中失效，因为企业工作区和云服务共享、持久、复制成本高或不可行，且动作可能引入不可逆副作用或跨轨迹干扰。现有生成式世界模型避免直接执行，但通常将环境状态压缩为单一提示，限制了其在部分可观测条件下可靠模拟转换的能力。相反，我们提出代理世界建模（AWM），将下一观测预测重构为多轮证据获取任务。对于每个假设动作，代理模拟器通过安全只读接口自适应地查询真实环境，推理返回的证据，并利用可执行计算构建结果观测，而不修改共享状态。集成轨迹级TTS后，AWM实现了在单一共享环境上的并行探索。在τ-bench、AppWorld和OfficeBench上，AWM平均比单次模拟基线提升40.07%，平均优于训练好的世界模型基线12.36%。这些结果确立了交互式、基于读取的世界模拟作为共享、不可重置环境中安全且可扩展的代理测试时扩展的实用基础。

summary: Voice-interactive large language models process both what a speaker says and how they say it, yet the two channels do not always agree. We ask whether that disagreement degrades speech emotion recognition. Mapping text and audio into a shared valence-arousal-dominance space, we convert the distance between them into a continuous, threshold-free incongruence score with a two-component Gaussian mixture, and validate the score against human judgement. We evaluate three audiocapable models on acted, conversational and spontaneous speech (eNTERFACE'05, MELD and CMU-MOSEI). With the model held constant across modalities, incongruence raises the odds of error whenever audio is present, in every corpus, after controlling for the ground-truth emotion and for distance in the feature space. Supervised classifiers trained on the same features behave in the opposite way, which suggests that the difficulty lies in how these models combine raw evidence rather than in the signal itself. Text-only effects are unreliable: swapping only the model that reads the transcript reverses their sign on one corpus. Rebuilding the score without the emotion lexicon reproduces the central result, and among six simpler alternatives it is the only label-free score that predicts error in all three corpora. Code, data tables and prompts are released.
title: Incongruence-Aware Evaluation of Multimodal Speech Emotion Recognition in Audio Large Language Models
title_translated: 多模态语音情感识别中不一致感知的评估：基于音频大语言模型
summary_translated: 语音交互的大语言模型同时处理说话者说了什么以及如何说，但这两个通道并不总是一致。我们探讨这种不一致是否会影响语音情感识别。通过将文本和音频映射到共享的效价-唤醒-主导性空间，我们利用双成分高斯混合模型将两者之间的距离转化为连续且无阈值的不一致得分，并与人类判断进行验证。我们在表演式、对话式和自发性语音数据集（eNTERFACE'05、MELD 和 CMU-MOSEI）上评估了三个具备音频能力的模型。在控制真实情感和特征空间距离的前提下，无论哪个语料库，只要存在音频，不一致都会提高出错概率。使用相同特征训练的监督分类器则表现出相反趋势，表明问题在于模型如何整合原始证据，而非信号本身。仅更换读取转录文本的模型会改变文本独有效应的方向，说明其不可靠。即使去除情感词典重建得分，核心结果依然成立；在六种更简单的替代方案中，只有该无标签得分能在所有三个语料库中预测错误。代码、数据表和提示均已公开。

summary: Training a large language model is compute-bound, and current recipes divide the work between optimizers by hand: orthogonalized momentum for attention and MLP matrices, Adam-style updates for the rest. This division rests on human priors about which layer type deserves which geometry, and it fixes a single global update budget that every parameter block shares. We introduce FARO, a function-space adaptive optimizer that makes the partition of parameters into blocks the unit of decision. FARO gives each block a geometry by its realized counterfactual return, then freezes the routes and reallocates the frozen per-block budget by cross-block equal risk contribution (ERC), the risk-parity principle from portfolio theory. On a GPT-style model trained on FineWeb, the framework gives two results. First, its FARO-Adaptive arm reaches 3.2780 nats at the full schedule, matching NorMuonAndAdam (3.2794), the best hand-designed recipe: it recovers the human prior without hand-setting per-layer geometry. Second, FARO-ERC improves on that arm: it lowers the clean-data loss at every one of 6 seeds, by 0.0136 nats on average, a modest but robust gain. Its sign test, paired test, and confidence interval all agree, and it exceeds the measured run-to-run noise at no added time or memory. It works by trimming the riskiest blocks rather than expanding the safest, and it holds up under a corrupted stream, still lowering the mean loss and winning the seed majority. The source code is available at https://github.com/wxj630/FARO.
title: FARO: Function-Space Adaptive Return-to-Risk Optimization via Cross-Block Equal-Risk-Contribution Budget Allocation
title_translated: FARO：基于跨块等风险贡献预算分配的功能空间自适应回报-风险优化
summary_translated: 训练大语言模型是计算密集型任务，当前方法依赖人工划分优化器的工作：对注意力和MLP矩阵使用正交化动量，其余部分采用类似Adam的更新方式。这种划分基于人类对不同层类型应具有何种几何结构的先验假设，并固定一个全局更新预算供所有参数块共享。我们提出FARO，一种功能空间自适应优化器，以参数块为决策单元。FARO根据每个块的实际反事实回报赋予其几何结构，随后冻结路径并基于跨块等风险贡献（ERC）原则重新分配各块预算，该原则源自投资组合理论中的风险平价思想。在基于FineWeb训练的GPT风格模型上，该框架取得两项成果：第一，其FARO-Adaptive模块在完整训练周期内达到3.2780纳特，与最佳人工设计方案NorMuonAndAdam（3.2794）相当，实现了无需手动设定每层几何结构的人类先验恢复；第二，FARO-ERC优于该模块：在6个种子实验中，平均降低干净数据损失0.0136纳特，虽为小幅但稳健提升。其符号检验、配对检验和置信区间均一致支持该结论，且超越了测量的运行间噪声，未增加时间和内存开销。其机制是裁剪最危险的块而非扩展最安全的块，在数据流受损情况下仍能降低平均损失并赢得多数种子实验。源代码已发布于https://github.com/wxj630/FARO。

summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables large language models to advance their capabilities through successive updates, but these updates can also introduce new risks and weaken existing safeguards. In line with the AI-45° Law, we pursue Safety RSI, in which safety develops as an intrinsic capability alongside general model capabilities through continual risk discovery and repair, while preserving utility and limiting over-refusal. We introduce Safin-1.5, a model built on a safety architecture and trained through recursive safety improvement, with an inference-time harness that extends its capabilities to formal reasoning. Our approach comprises three components: i) The safety architecture combines persistent safety states with hazardous-knowledge disentanglement. The former retains and selectively invokes safety knowledge, while the latter relocates targeted hazardous knowledge into removable experts, enabling its removal with minimal impact on general capabilities. ii) Recursive safety improvement establishes a discovery-evaluation-repair loop. The loop identifies new vulnerabilities and uses experimental feedback to develop repair strategies. It accepts updates only when they improve safety while preserving general capabilities and limiting over-refusal. iii) The formal reasoning harness combines the model's language understanding with symbolic inference and verification. Proof-obligation-guided semantic bridging recovers missing relations in formal representations, enabling symbolic solvers to construct checkable proofs under formalized premises and accepted semantic bridges. Experimental results demonstrate that Safin-1.5 achieves safety and reasoning performance, outperforming frontier models.
title: Safin-1.5: Safety-Native Architecture and Verifiable Reasoning for Recursive Safety Improvement
title_translated: Safin-1.5：面向递归安全改进的安全原生架构与可验证推理
summary_translated: 递归自我改进（RSI）使大语言模型能够通过连续更新提升能力，但这些更新也可能引入新风险并削弱现有防护机制。遵循AI-45°定律，我们追求安全型递归自我改进（Safety RSI），即在持续发现和修复风险的过程中，让安全性作为通用能力的一部分同步发展，同时保持实用性并限制过度拒绝。我们提出Safin-1.5，一种基于安全架构并经过递归安全改进训练的模型，其推理时的工具链可扩展至形式化推理。该方法包含三个组件：i）安全架构结合持久安全状态与危险知识解耦，前者保留并选择性调用安全知识，后者将特定危险知识移入可移除专家模块，实现最小影响下的移除；ii）递归安全改进建立发现-评估-修复循环，识别新漏洞并通过实验反馈开发修复策略，仅当更新能提升安全性、保持通用能力且限制过度拒绝时才接受；iii）形式化推理工具链融合模型的语言理解能力与符号推理和验证能力。通过证明义务引导的语义桥接，恢复形式表示中缺失的关系，使符号求解器能在形式化前提和被接受的语义桥接下构建可验证证明。实验结果表明，Safin-1.5在安全性和推理性能方面均优于前沿模型。

summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is vulnerable to knowledge poisoning, where adversaries manipulate retrieved evidence to influence model outputs. Existing defenses are primarily evaluated using attack success rate (ASR), which obscures defense-induced failures and the mechanisms behind apparent attack prevention. To address this issue, this work introduces \textbf{Aligned RAG Evaluation}, a matched-query protocol that jointly examines clean and poisoned responses, with and without defense. By combining matched conditions analysis, LLM-judge endorsement, and retrieval dependence controls, the proposed framework distinguishes prevented from introduced failures, target mentions from LLM endorsement, and single-passage influence from evidence composition. Experiments on HotpotQA and Natural Questions reveal that existing defenses can introduce unexpected target-positive answers, although they can prevent some attacks, while evaluation criteria can also change defense rankings. Our findings expose critical blind spots in ASR-based evaluation and motivate a more comprehensive assessment of RAG poisoning defenses. The code and the evaluation artifact are available at https://github.com/chxhana/aligned-rag-eval.
title: Prevented is Not Protected: What Attack Success Rate Hides about RAG
title_translated: 预防≠保护：攻击成功率如何掩盖RAG的真相
summary_translated: 检索增强生成（RAG）易受知识污染攻击，攻击者通过操纵检索到的证据来影响模型输出。现有防御措施主要通过攻击成功率（ASR）进行评估，但这会掩盖防御带来的失败及其背后机制。为解决此问题，本文提出	extbf{对齐RAG评估}，一种匹配查询协议，联合考察清洁与污染响应，有无防御条件下的表现。通过结合匹配条件分析、大模型裁判支持及检索依赖控制，所提框架可区分“被阻止”与“被引入”的失败、目标提及与大模型认可、单段落影响与证据组合的影响。在HotpotQA和Natural Questions上的实验显示，现有防御可能引入意外的目标正面回答，尽管能防止部分攻击，且评估标准也会改变防御排名。研究揭示了基于ASR评估的关键盲点，推动对RAG知识污染防御进行更全面的评估。代码与评估资源已发布于https://github.com/chxhana/aligned-rag-eval。

summary: A capable voice assistant must do more than recognize words; it must understand requests, reason over context, sustain conversations, and act through tools. We present Apriel Voice 27B Preview, an open speech-language model that unifies these capabilities within a shared reasoning backbone while retaining text and image input modalities. Built on the post-trained Gemma 4 26B-A4B checkpoint, Apriel Voice directly processes speech and generates both responses and tool calls without requiring a separate dialogue model. We introduce a two-stage training procedure to adapt the model to speech. The first stage establishes the speech interface, while the second jointly adapts the projector and backbone through supervised fine-tuning, text replay, and source-dependent cross-entropy and forward Kullback--Leibler divergence supervision. Automatically constructed speech-conditioned dialogues provide conversational training data, while local teacher serving, overlapping teacher and student computation, and fused full-vocabulary losses enable efficient online distillation. In thinking mode, Apriel Voice achieves a score of 98.90 on Big Bench Audio, 81.13 on Speech-BFCL, and a task success rate of 65.51% on $τ$-Voice, with a mean latency of 1.91 seconds. It also achieves 51.27% English EVA accuracy and 74.13% experience pass@1. Finally, we deploy Apriel Voice 27B Preview on a custom serving platform to support interactive voice interactions.
title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
title_translated: Apriel Voice 27B 预览版：面向语音、推理与工具使用的开源模型
summary_translated: 一个强大的语音助手不仅需要识别词汇，还需理解请求、在上下文中推理、维持对话并借助工具执行操作。我们提出Apriel Voice 27B Preview，一个开源的语音-语言模型，将这些能力统一于共享的推理主干中，同时保留文本和图像输入模态。基于预训练的Gemma 4 26B-A4B检查点构建，Apriel Voice可直接处理语音输入并生成响应与工具调用，无需独立对话模型。我们引入两阶段训练流程以适配语音：第一阶段建立语音接口，第二阶段通过监督微调、文本重播、源相关交叉熵和前向Kullback-Leibler散度监督联合调整投影器与主干。自动构建的语音条件对话提供对话训练数据，而本地教师服务、教师与学生计算重叠及融合全词汇损失实现高效在线蒸馏。在思考模式下，Apriel Voice在Big Bench Audio上得分为98.90，在Speech-BFCL上为81.13，在$τ$-Voice任务上成功率达65.51%，平均延迟为1.91秒。此外，其英文EVA准确率为51.27%，经验通过率pass@1为74.13%。最后，我们将Apriel Voice 27B Preview部署于定制服务平台，以支持交互式语音互动。

summary: Calibrating a cosmological simulation is an expensive, high-dimensional parameter optimization task. Previous works employ Bayesian optimization for automation, which treats the simulator as a black box and precludes the incorporation of human domain knowledge or workflow into the selection policy. We propose AgenticTuner, an agentic calibration pipeline with a present-day large language model serving as the optimizer who proposes the next parameter trial. We show that these agents can achieve competitive calibration performance at a fraction of the CPU cost when they are given informal, human-readable priors (such as codebase, documentation, and heuristic guides that seasoned scientists may possess). We hope this work serves as an early step toward AI scientists that can carry out complex, long-horizon scientific tasks.
title: Agentic Systems for Calibrating Cosmological Simulations
comment: Accepted to the 9th annual workshop for Machine Learning & the Physical Sciences (ML4PS). A starter code is available on this https URL
title_translated: 用于校准宇宙学模拟的智能体系统
summary_translated: 校准宇宙学模拟是一项昂贵且高维度的参数优化任务。以往的工作采用贝叶斯优化来实现自动化，将模拟器视为黑箱，无法融入人类领域知识或工作流程到选择策略中。我们提出了AgenticTuner，一个基于当代大型语言模型作为优化器的智能体校准流程，该优化器会提出下一步的参数试验。我们证明，当给予这些智能体非正式的人类可读先验信息（如代码库、文档和资深科学家所掌握的经验指南）时，它们能够在极低的CPU成本下达到具有竞争力的校准性能。我们希望这项工作能成为迈向能够执行复杂、长周期科学任务的AI科学家的早期一步。
